description:
Mobile Engineer React Native (100% Remote) Worldwide

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting‑edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education : Democratizing access to top‑tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

We have launched Keet Mobile on iOS and Android, bringing our full P2P technology stack to everyone. Keet Mobile is not your average app: it’s heavy lifting is performed by a custom JS runtime specially designed for peer-to-peer usage (in fact, it reuses 100% of Keet Desktop’s code!). The UI logic, on the other hand, is 100% React Native, giving us flexibility and the ability to iterate quickly.

We believe this pattern opens the door to huge possibilities in the future, and we need your help getting there!

Responsibilities

In this role, you will develop and maintain Keet Mobile, our peer-to-peer chat and calling app for iOS and Android. Keet Mobile is built with React Native and Expo, and its P2P core runs on the device itself in a Bare worklet. You’ll own features end to end, from UI/UX implementation to using the P2P core apis.

You will:

  • Build and polish features across chat, voice and video calls, media sharing, device pairing and identity backup
  • Integrate native platform capabilities such as push notifications, camera, bio-metrics and background tasks on both iOS and Android
  • Profile and optimise performance on real devices, including startup time, long chats, media handling, battery and network use
  • Write unit and end-to-end tests, and help keep releases stable through CI and crash reporting
  • Work closely with the core P2P, design and product teams, and review code with a high bar for quality

Significant experience with React Native, Redux for state management and Redux-Saga

Experienced with WebSockets, RESTful based APIs.

Knowledge in native languages (Swift/Kotlin) and familiarity with native build tools (Xcode/Android Studio) is advantageous.

Experience working with a remote team

Interested in modernizing and optimizing different mobile or web applications.

Bonus points if you have any built something amazing on any p2p frameworks .

About the job

Our pioneering P2P development platform, built on our open-source technology stack, Pear, eliminates the need for traditional server infrastructure. Pear platform facilitates direct deployment of applications from the developer’s machine to the user, enabling seamless scalability and performance. By leveraging Node.js-based technology akin to BitTorrent, we create robust peer-to-peer connections and data replication systems that set the foundation for a decentralized web.

Learn more about Pear: docs.pears.com

Keet, our flagship P2P communications app, is the first step towards this new era. It exemplifies the potential of P2P technology in everyday applications, from messaging and file sharing to complex collaborative environments, all while maintaining user sovereignty over personal data.

Learn more about Keet: keet.io

Responsibilities

In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining Keet Desktop, our cross-platform P2P communications application built with React and running on the Pear runtime. You’ll work on everything from UI/UX implementation to performance optimization, helping shape the future of decentralized communication.

Strong competency in state management (Redux, Redux Toolkit, Zustand, or similar).

Ability to write modular, maintainable, and well tested code.

Solid skillset in testing & debugging complex frontend applications.

Deep interest or experience with P2P technologies or distributed systems.

Comfort working in a remote, globally distributed team; good communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with desktop application development (Electron, Tauri, or similar runtimes).

Familiarity with video/audio APIs (WebRTC, media streams) and real-time communication.

Demonstrated ability to optimize UI performance: rendering, memory management.

Bonus: Past contributions to OSS projects, especially in P2P or decentralized tech.

About SaniSure

SaniSure is a high-growth multinational manufacturer of single-use products and systems used in the production of biological drugs, including cell therapies, gene therapies, and vaccines. With operations in the U.S. and Europe, we supply global pharmaceutical and biotech companies with the critical tools they need to develop and manufacture some of today's most innovative and life-changing medicines.

As we continue to expand our product offerings and global footprint, SaniSure offers an exciting opportunity to join a nimble, customer-focused company at the forefront of the biotech industry.

Job Summary

The Shipping & Receiving Manager leads all inbound, outbound, and warehouse operations at SaniSure’s Twinsburg, Ohio extrusion facility, managing the team and the safe, compliant flow of raw materials, work-in-process, and finished goods in support of production and customer commitments. This position must be exceptionally detail oriented and able to track multiple facets of the warehouse at all times, with accountability for inventory accuracy, customer order fulfillment, Safety & Quality culture, and compliance and control.

Essential Functions

  • Lead all shipping, receiving, and warehouse operations, enforcing policies and procedures that drive a strong culture of Safety, Quality, and Continuous Improvement.
  • Manage receiving, material handling, storage, picking, packing, and shipping of raw materials, work-in-process, and finished goods to support extrusion production and customer commitments.
  • Ensure compliance with ISO, OSHA, cGMP, and other requirements by working with Quality to develop procedures and enforce adherence; maintain audit readiness and support internal, customer, and regulatory audits.
  • Drive continuous improvement and closed-loop issue resolution using Lean, 5S, PDCA, RCCA, and 5-Why; ensure timely closure of CARs in the QMS and develop CAR owners within the team.
  • Own inventory accuracy in the ERP (Syteline preferred): direct cycle counts and physical inventories, and run or develop ERP reports for transactional cleanup and performance monitoring.
  • Manage carriers and evaluate inbound and outbound freight costs and methods for domestic and international lanes; ensure accurate shipping documentation and trade compliance.
  • Partner with Production, Planning, Quality, Purchasing, and Customer Service to align materials and shipments with production schedules and customer orders.
  • Report monthly KPIs (safety, on-time shipment, inventory accuracy, cost) to upper management; prepare and manage the annual budget and analyze variances.
  • Monitor task-to-manpower ratios, address bottlenecks, and plan layouts to optimize flow and support growth.
  • Ensure equipment is properly maintained and establish security procedures to safeguard warehouse contents.
  • Recruit, train, coach, schedule, and appraise employees, including discipline as needed; ensure 100% training adherence.
  • Enforce workplace safety, including forklift safety and PPE use; lead incident investigations.
  • Aid in the creation and revision of SOPs and Work Instructions; perform other duties as assigned.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, Operations, Engineering, or a related field preferred; HS Diploma or equivalent with more than 5 years of experience managing a warehouse or operations environment will be considered.

Required Experience & Competencies

  • 7+ years of shipping, receiving, warehouse, or logistics experience in manufacturing, including 3+ years in a supervisory or management role, with demonstrated ability to manage multiple warehouse functional areas.
  • Strong leadership, interpersonal, and communication skills (oral and written), with the ability to develop a team and work effectively with all levels of staff, customers, and carriers.
  • Excellent problem-solving, organization, and attention-to-detail skills; ability to prioritize and multi-task.
  • Experience in inventory control practices and in using or implementing Lean Six Sigma methodology.
  • Proficient in Microsoft applications and ERP systems; Syteline experience a plus.
  • Knowledge of safety procedures, equipment maintenance, warehouse best practices, and GMP/ISO quality systems; extrusion or plastics manufacturing experience a plus.
  • Forklift certified (or able to obtain certification upon hire) for Class 1 to 7, with the ability to train others.
  • Ability to perform physical activity, including lifting up to 35 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Requires valid Driver License and proof of automobile insurance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, or Business.
  • Certifications (SCM, CPIM, CLTD, CPDW); pharmaceutical, medical device, or health care experience; bilingual.

title: Senior MacOS QA Engineer
location: Portugal; Germany; Poland; Serbia; Boshnya, Brest Region, Belarus
description:
As the Senior macOS QA Engineer, you will be responsible for validating the stability, security, and compatibility of a secure macOS platform used to protect sensitive systems. This is a hands-on manual and exploratory QA role (not an automation role) that requires deep, practical experience with macOS internals, system extensions, and application behavior. You will work alongside a highly experienced team of engineers and reverse engineers to design and execute manual test plans that dig into system extensions, inter-process communication, and low-level operating system behavior.

If you thrive on identifying edge cases, love all things macOS, enjoy breaking complex systems in controlled ways, and have an investigative mindset for system behavior, this role is for you.

This is not a fit if macOS has been a secondary platform, or if your experience is mainly iOS, web or automation.

Responsibilities

  • Test macOS security features spanning system extensions, Endpoint Security, and Network Extension frameworks.
  • Design and execute manual test plans for system extensions, inter-process communication (XPC), and low-level operating system integration points.
  • Explore and document edge cases, race conditions, compatibility scenarios, and regressions across macOS versions.
  • Reproduce and isolate complex issues related to sandboxing, SIP and TCC interactions, Launch Services, and daemon behaviors.
  • Work directly with development, support, product, and automation teams to triage, verify, and regress bugs and compatibility issues.
  • Validate interactions between the platform and third-party macOS apps and services.
  • Collaborate with SDETs to turn exploratory and regression cases into automation candidates.
  • Maintain close familiarity with changes in macOS releases and how they may impact functionality and compatibility.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of QA experience with macOS applications, with a focus on security, system-level, or compatibility testing.
  • Strong understanding of macOS internals, including System Extensions, Endpoint Security, XPC, TCC, SIP, Launch Services, and file systems.
  • Familiarity with macOS diagnostic and monitoring tools such as Console, Activity Monitor, Instruments, fs_usage, dtrace, tcpdump, and lldb.
  • Experience testing low-level products such as VPNs, endpoint security tools, or antivirus software.
  • Ability to read crash reports and debug logs and identify root causes.
  • Ability to work independently and investigate issues thoroughly before escalating.
  • Excellent written communication for clear test case documentation and bug reports.
  • Comfortable working in Terminal (launchctl, log, systemextensionsctl, tccutil)
  • Able to set up and fully clean test environments (VMs/snapshots, removing extensions, resetting permissions)
  • Availability to work during US Eastern Time (EST) business hours.
  • Claims will be checked: Interviews include hands-on questions about the experience listed on your CV.

Benefits

  • Compensation: Based on experience
  • PTO and holidays

** Only CVs submitted in English will be considered **

At Darwoft, we build custom software solutions and partner with international companies to create high-impact digital products.

We are a Latin American technology company with a people-first culture, strong professional standards, and a long-term partnership mindset. We work with distributed teams, complex technical challenges, and clients whose technology has a direct impact on their businesses and users.

About the Project

We are partnering with an innovative cybersecurity company building a next-generation Identity Security and Identity Observability platform .

The product helps enterprise security teams understand how human users, service accounts, workloads, applications, and AI-driven identities access systems across cloud, SaaS, network, endpoint, and on-premise environments .

At the core of the platform is a highly data-intensive architecture that collects and analyzes large volumes of events, logs, network telemetry, identity activity, and security signals . This information is processed to identify unusual access patterns, security risks, identity blind spots, infrastructure misconfigurations, and potential threats.

Utilizar filtros y lógica condicional para segmentar datos y analizar grupos específicos.

Limpiar, procesar y categorizar datos de texto no estructurados o semiestructurados.

Convertir estructuras de datos y resultados técnicos en resúmenes claros, bullet points o tablas para equipos y stakeholders de habla inglesa.

Requerimientos

Inglés avanzado, tanto escrito como hablado.

Conocimientos básicos a intermedios de SQL, incluyendo JOINs, agregaciones y lógica condicional con CASE WHEN.

Experiencia utilizando Python para limpieza, manipulación y procesamiento de datos, con buen manejo de pandas para transformaciones de datos.

Familiaridad con librerías como scikit-learn o statsmodels para desarrollar y evaluar modelos predictivos o estadísticos.

Experiencia trabajando con datos de texto: limpieza, procesamiento, filtros y búsqueda de patrones dentro de strings.

Buen entendimiento de bases de datos relacionales, incluyendo relaciones entre tablas, primary keys, foreign keys y normalización.

Título universitario en Business Analytics, Estadística, Matemáticas, Ciencias de la Computación, Economía, Marketing o carreras relacionadas, idealmente con formación en bases de datos o análisis cuantitativo.

Será un plus si tienes

Experiencia trabajando con datos de consumidores, retail, paneles o transacciones.

Familiaridad con data warehouses en la nube como Snowflake, BigQuery o Redshift.

Experiencia o conocimientos en marketing analytics, consumer insights o market measurement.

Experiencia creando tablas o vistas de datos que alimenten dashboards y reportes recurrentes.

10 días de PTO para que puedas desconectarte.

100% remoto: trabaja desde donde estés y encuentra el equilibrio que mejor funcione para ti.

Forma parte de equipos y proyectos internacionales, trabajando con profesionales de distintos países.

Get to Know Darwoft

At Darwoft, we build custom software solutions and partner with international companies to create high-impact digital products.

We are a Latin American technology company with a people-first culture, strong professional standards, and a long-term partnership mindset. We work with distributed teams, complex technical challenges, and clients whose technology has a direct impact on their businesses and users.

About the Project

We are partnering with an innovative cybersecurity company building a next-generation Identity Security and Identity Observability platform .

The product helps enterprise security teams understand how human users, service accounts, workloads, applications, and AI-driven identities access systems across cloud, SaaS, network, endpoint, and on-premise environments .

At the core of the platform is a highly data-intensive architecture that collects and analyzes large volumes of events, logs, network telemetry, identity activity, and security signals . This information is processed to identify unusual access patterns, security risks, identity blind spots, infrastructure misconfigurations, and potential threats.

The platform integrates with complex enterprise ecosystems including identity providers, cloud platforms, SASE solutions, SIEMs, endpoint security tools, network infrastructure, and security services.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer focused on Data Ingestion, Integrations, and Collectors to become a key technical bridge between enterprise customers and the engineering organization.

This is not a traditional backend or internal data engineering position.

You'll work directly with customers to understand their infrastructure, data sources, security architecture, network topology, APIs, and workflows, then design and implement scalable mechanisms to ingest that information into the platform.

You'll combine data engineering, software engineering, solution architecture, cloud infrastructure, and technical consulting .

A major part of your mission will be building and evolving connectors and ingestion pipelines capable of integrating data from complex enterprise environments while maintaining reliability, scalability, security, and fast time-to-production.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design, develop, and maintain production-grade data collectors, connectors, and ingestion services .
  • Integrate enterprise data sources including identity providers, cloud platforms, SASE solutions, network infrastructure, endpoints, applications, security platforms, and SIEM systems .
  • Work directly with enterprise customers to understand their environments, data flows, APIs, security requirements, and integration constraints.
  • Participate in technical onboarding processes, from initial discovery and architecture design through production deployment.
  • Design scalable ingestion architectures for processing security events, logs, identity activity, network telemetry, and other high-volume data sources .
  • Build integrations using REST APIs, cloud-native services, event-driven architectures, and modern software engineering practices .
  • Develop backend services primarily using Python and/or Go .
  • Work with SQL and NoSQL databases to store, transform, query, and analyze high-volume data.
  • Build and operate containerized services using Docker and Kubernetes .
  • Deploy and integrate solutions across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments .
  • Troubleshoot complex customer deployment and integration issues across application, infrastructure, networking, API, and data layers.
  • Optimize ingestion performance, reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with Solution Architects, Sales Engineering, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering teams.
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor around customer data architecture, collection strategies, security integrations, and implementation best practices.
  • Identify recurring customer requirements and transform them into reusable connectors, platform capabilities, or improvements to the core product.
  • Contribute technical insights from real-world implementations to the product roadmap.
  • Support production adoption and continuously improve time-to-value for enterprise customers.
  • Participate in occasional customer-facing technical sessions and, when necessary, onsite engagements.

What You Bring

  • 10+ years of professional Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, or related experience.
  • Strong software development experience with:
    • Python
    • Go
  • Strong experience designing and consuming REST APIs .
  • Hands-on experience building data ingestion pipelines, connector frameworks, integration platforms, or similar systems .
  • Experience integrating complex enterprise systems and third-party platforms.
  • Solid understanding of both SQL and NoSQL databases .
  • Production experience with at least one major cloud platform:
    • AWS
    • Azure
    • GCP
  • Experience working with Docker and Kubernetes .
  • Strong understanding of Git-based development workflows and CI/CD practices .
  • Experience designing reliable, scalable, and production-ready distributed systems.
  • Strong debugging skills across APIs, infrastructure, networking, application services, and data pipelines.
  • Experience working directly with customers, stakeholders, or technical partners.
  • Ability to translate complex customer requirements into pragmatic technical solutions.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to operate effectively in customer-facing technical conversations.
  • High degree of autonomy and ownership when solving ambiguous technical problems.

Highly Relevant Experience

Experience with any of the following will be especially valuable:

  • IAM
  • IdPs
  • Identity Security
  • Cybersecurity platforms
  • SIEM systems
  • Security telemetry
  • Network security
  • Endpoint security
  • SASE / Zero Trust environments
  • Cloud security
  • Large-scale event processing
  • Streaming architectures

Integration Experience

Previous experience integrating APIs or data from platforms such as the following is highly valuable:

  • AWS
  • Microsoft Azure
  • Google Cloud
  • Microsoft Entra ID / Active Directory
  • Okta
  • Google Workspace
  • Duo
  • CrowdStrike
  • Zscaler
  • Palo Alto
  • Microsoft Defender
  • SIEM and security analytics platforms

Direct experience with every platform is not required. What matters is a strong track record of learning complex APIs and transforming heterogeneous enterprise data sources into reliable integrations.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with large-scale data processing or streaming platforms.
  • Experience designing reusable connector SDKs or integration frameworks .
  • Understanding of identity-related security concepts such as authentication, authorization, credentials, service accounts, privileged access, and non-human identities.
  • Experience with security events, audit logs, network telemetry, or cloud activity data.
  • Familiarity with event-driven and distributed system architectures.
  • Experience deploying AI/ML-enabled applications.
  • Exposure to LLMs, AI agents, or AI-powered security applications .
  • Solution Architecture or Forward Deployed Engineering experience.
  • Previous experience in cybersecurity startups or high-growth SaaS environments.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role will be measured by your ability to:

  • Deliver successful enterprise integrations and deployments.
  • Reduce customer time-to-production.
  • Build reliable and scalable ingestion solutions.
  • Improve customer adoption and technical satisfaction.
  • Resolve complex integration challenges efficiently.
  • Turn customer-specific requirements into reusable platform capabilities.
  • Contribute improvements that strengthen the scalability and flexibility of the core product.

What Darwoft Offers

  • 100% remote work
  • Argentina's public holidays

  • Referral program
  • Access to learning platforms

description:
About the role

You’ll help set the technical direction for Willow’s platform and be hands-on in the code every day, personally taking on some of our biggest technical challenges. You’ll shape architecture across teams, set engineering standards, and mentor engineers so that we ship secure, reliable, high-quality software at scale. This is a senior individual contributor role, not a people-management position.

You’ll work across Engineering, Product, Customer Engineering, Sales and Marketing, and with partners, often across time zones. We’re looking for someone who has had real influence across a whole company, not just a single team.

What you'll own

Architecture & technical direction

  • Own the architecture of complex, cloud-based systems on Azure, including containers, graph storage, LLMs, and a wide range of Azure services.
  • Stay hands-on: write production code and lead the design of new initiatives.
  • Design integrations with partners and customer systems that work smoothly across multiple companies.

Engineering standards & quality

  • Set technical standards, such as approved languages, libraries, Azure resources and framework versions, and make sure teams apply them consistently.
  • Raise the bar on code quality, observability and reliability across all of Willow’s software, including design and code reviews across teams.
  • Lead secure engineering practices and keep reducing vulnerabilities.

Cross-functional partnership

  • Work with Product to shape the product vision and explain trade-off decisions in terms of customer value.
  • Partner with Customer Engineering, Sales and Marketing to turn business needs into technical solutions.
  • Advise senior leadership on technical and product strategy.

Mentorship & engineering culture

  • Mentor senior and lead engineers.
  • Build a culture of transparency, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
  • Help teams use AI tools well in how they build, and in what we build.

What success looks like in year one

  • Determine a path forward for Willow’s building topology graph storage that is secure, performant, cost-effective, and scalable, working closely with key Willow partners on cutting-edge solutions to difficult problems.
  • Own the features that make data in the graph available to the Willow Copilot AI platform and other parts of the platform.
  • Work daily with other developers at Willow to optimize the entire application platform, resolve issues, and design the architecture Willow needs to scale rapidly as we grow.

What we're looking for

Required

  • 10+ years of commercial software development, including senior or principal-level technical leadership
  • Deep expertise in C# and modern .NET, plus working knowledge of TypeScript, React and Python
  • A track record of designing, building and running distributed systems on Azure, using its PaaS services in production
  • Strong command of design patterns and software architecture, and the ability to teach them to others
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD, infrastructure as code and DevOps practices
  • Proven influence across teams and functions, with company-level technical decisions you can point to
  • A security-first mindset, with experience leading secure development practices
  • Clear writing and strong asynchronous communication with distributed teams across time zones
  • Hands-on use of AI tools in your day-to-day work, and the ability to speak knowledgeably about how you use them

Preferred

  • IoT, digital twin or building-systems data (for example time series and graph data, or Azure Digital Twins / Microsoft Fabric)
  • AI/ML in production: LLM platforms, MLOps pipelines, or AI features built into a SaaS product

Nice to have

  • Data platforms such as Snowflake or Azure data services
  • Pulumi or similar infrastructure-as-code tooling, plus Grafana or other observability tools
  • Experience at a global start-up or scale-up

How you work

  • You design systems to optimize growth, performance, and cost.
  • You take pride in ownership and in your ability to deliver results and ship stable features.
  • You thrive when working with others, building consensus, and growing the entire team.

Who we can picture in this role

Two people we can picture in this role. The first is a senior developer from a large organization who is strong on the Azure stack, and is ready to take on ownership of major projects, work with new technologies, and become a leader. The second is someone who has spent time in the startup space as a principal engineer, has experience scaling an entire company from a few customers to hundreds, and can see around the corners on the path to 10x growth. These are illustrations, not a specification — if you are neither of these but have the skills and experience the role needs, we would still very much like to hear from you.

$200,000 – $220,000 base salary per year

Exact offer reflects your experience and skills.

HEALTH COVERAGE

Medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, Life & AD&D

100% of employee premiums covered; 95% of dependent premiums covered by Willow.

RETIREMENT

title: Staff Software Engineer - APAC Onboarding and KYC
description:
Company Description

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
For everyone, everywhere.

More about our mission and what we offer.

Job Description

Salary range: 185,000 - 230,000 SGD base per annum + RSUs

At Wise, we’re on a mission to make money borderless, instant, and convenient for millions of people and businesses worldwide. Our engineers are at the heart of this mission, solving complex challenges and building seamless, secure solutions that customers love.

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our APAC (Asia Pacific) Onboarding and KYC team, in the Singapore office.

APAC customers are a strong contributor to the Wise's growth. A big part of this growth comes from new customer acquisitions, so having a fast, convenient and delightful customer onboarding journey is central to this growth. That’s the mission of the APAC Onboarding team, and we’re looking for people who can make this happen. If this sounds like an exciting challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

Here’s how you’ll be contributing to the team

  • Design scalable onboarding solutions tailored to diverse APAC markets, reducing redundancies and driving up conversion rates

  • Implement scalable KYC controls across multiple regulatory markets with minimal friction in the customer journey

  • Build and maintain automations and tooling to process customer documents and other sensitive identity data in a scalable and cost-efficient way

  • Utilise the observability stack and analytics to identify gaps, and unlock new opportunities for growth and operational excellence

  • Help with the technical roadmap of the team and ensure its progress and delivery

Qualifications

A bit about you

  • You have at least 10 years of professional experience in software engineering or related roles, with a proven track record of delivering high-impact, production-grade systems

  • You have extensive experience with JVM-based systems (Java 17+) and the Spring Boot ecosystem

  • You have led the architecture and delivery of large-scale systems that have had a measurable impact on business outcomes beyond a single team

  • You have spent at least 3 years in a technical leadership role, where you were leading project teams and setting technical direction for the team

  • You possess deep expertise in distributed systems and have designed highly available, fault-tolerant services

  • You have experience working with relational and non-relational databases, schema design and query optimisation

  • You approach challenges with a strong product mindset, using data-driven insights to fix complex customer pain points

  • You can articulate high-level technical strategies to non-technical stakeholders and provide mentorship to senior engineers

  • You are familiar with deployment frameworks and have experience managing the full lifecycle of a service, from design to deployment to production observability

…but don’t worry we don’t expect you to know everything!

Some extra skills and experiences that would be great:

  • You have experience with financial systems, particularly how money moves globally

  • You understand the technical challenges of integrating third-party verification providers, managing sensitive identity, and building modular KYC workflows that can be adapted for different regulatory bodies

What you can expect as an Engineer at Wise:

We don't measure seniority purely by years of experience, but also by the impact you create and the complexity of problems you can help solve. As a Staff software Engineer at Wise, you would be given the licence to:

  • Lead large (>10 engineering weeks) sized projects that have a meaningful impact on Wise product and customers

  • Own the technical domain of your team with a view on how it should move forward

  • Propose ideas to improve and grow your team’s product

  • Embrace long-term ownership of projects while training other engineers to reduce single points of failure

  • Architect and design services that allow for iterative delivery and future scaling

  • Collaborate closely across functions like product, analytics, design, and operations to ensure smooth and effective delivery

To get the best view of what we expect at all levels of our engineering team, you can take a look at our Engineering Career Map

Additional Information

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Get to Know Darwoft

At Darwoft, we build custom software solutions and partner with international companies to create high-impact digital products.

We are a Latin American technology company with a people-first culture, strong professional standards, and a long-term partnership mindset. We work with distributed teams, complex technical challenges, and clients whose technology has a direct impact on their businesses and users.

About the Project

We are partnering with an innovative cybersecurity company building a next-generation Identity Security and Identity Observability platform .

The product helps enterprise security teams understand how human users, service accounts, workloads, applications, and AI-driven identities access systems across cloud, SaaS, network, endpoint, and on-premise environments .

At the core of the platform is a highly data-intensive architecture that collects and analyzes large volumes of events, logs, network telemetry, identity activity, and security signals . This information is processed to identify unusual access patterns, security risks, identity blind spots, infrastructure misconfigurations, and potential threats.

The platform integrates with complex enterprise ecosystems including identity providers, cloud platforms, SASE solutions, SIEMs, endpoint security tools, network infrastructure, and security services.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer focused on Data Ingestion, Integrations, and Collectors to become a key technical bridge between enterprise customers and the engineering organization.

This is not a traditional backend or internal data engineering position.

You'll work directly with customers to understand their infrastructure, data sources, security architecture, network topology, APIs, and workflows, then design and implement scalable mechanisms to ingest that information into the platform.

You'll combine data engineering, software engineering, solution architecture, cloud infrastructure, and technical consulting .

A major part of your mission will be building and evolving connectors and ingestion pipelines capable of integrating data from complex enterprise environments while maintaining reliability, scalability, security, and fast time-to-production.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design, develop, and maintain production-grade data collectors, connectors, and ingestion services .
  • Integrate enterprise data sources including identity providers, cloud platforms, SASE solutions, network infrastructure, endpoints, applications, security platforms, and SIEM systems .
  • Work directly with enterprise customers to understand their environments, data flows, APIs, security requirements, and integration constraints.
  • Participate in technical onboarding processes, from initial discovery and architecture design through production deployment.
  • Design scalable ingestion architectures for processing security events, logs, identity activity, network telemetry, and other high-volume data sources .
  • Build integrations using REST APIs, cloud-native services, event-driven architectures, and modern software engineering practices .
  • Develop backend services primarily using Python and/or Go .
  • Work with SQL and NoSQL databases to store, transform, query, and analyze high-volume data.
  • Build and operate containerized services using Docker and Kubernetes .
  • Deploy and integrate solutions across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments .
  • Troubleshoot complex customer deployment and integration issues across application, infrastructure, networking, API, and data layers.
  • Optimize ingestion performance, reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with Solution Architects, Sales Engineering, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering teams.
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor around customer data architecture, collection strategies, security integrations, and implementation best practices.
  • Identify recurring customer requirements and transform them into reusable connectors, platform capabilities, or improvements to the core product.
  • Contribute technical insights from real-world implementations to the product roadmap.
  • Support production adoption and continuously improve time-to-value for enterprise customers.
  • Participate in occasional customer-facing technical sessions and, when necessary, onsite engagements.

What You Bring

  • 10+ years of professional Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, or related experience.
  • Strong software development experience with:
    • Python
    • Go
  • Strong experience designing and consuming REST APIs .
  • Hands-on experience building data ingestion pipelines, connector frameworks, integration platforms, or similar systems .
  • Experience integrating complex enterprise systems and third-party platforms.
  • Solid understanding of both SQL and NoSQL databases .
  • Production experience with at least one major cloud platform:
    • AWS
    • Azure
    • GCP
  • Experience working with Docker and Kubernetes .
  • Strong understanding of Git-based development workflows and CI/CD practices .
  • Experience designing reliable, scalable, and production-ready distributed systems.
  • Strong debugging skills across APIs, infrastructure, networking, application services, and data pipelines.
  • Experience working directly with customers, stakeholders, or technical partners.
  • Ability to translate complex customer requirements into pragmatic technical solutions.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to operate effectively in customer-facing technical conversations.
  • High degree of autonomy and ownership when solving ambiguous technical problems.

Highly Relevant Experience

Experience with any of the following will be especially valuable:

  • IAM
  • IdPs
  • Identity Security
  • Cybersecurity platforms
  • SIEM systems
  • Security telemetry
  • Network security
  • Endpoint security
  • SASE / Zero Trust environments
  • Cloud security
  • Large-scale event processing
  • Streaming architectures

Integration Experience

Previous experience integrating APIs or data from platforms such as the following is highly valuable:

  • AWS
  • Microsoft Azure
  • Google Cloud
  • Microsoft Entra ID / Active Directory
  • Okta
  • Google Workspace
  • Duo
  • CrowdStrike
  • Zscaler
  • Palo Alto
  • Microsoft Defender
  • SIEM and security analytics platforms

Direct experience with every platform is not required. What matters is a strong track record of learning complex APIs and transforming heterogeneous enterprise data sources into reliable integrations.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with large-scale data processing or streaming platforms.
  • Experience designing reusable connector SDKs or integration frameworks .
  • Understanding of identity-related security concepts such as authentication, authorization, credentials, service accounts, privileged access, and non-human identities.
  • Experience with security events, audit logs, network telemetry, or cloud activity data.
  • Familiarity with event-driven and distributed system architectures.
  • Experience deploying AI/ML-enabled applications.
  • Exposure to LLMs, AI agents, or AI-powered security applications .
  • Solution Architecture or Forward Deployed Engineering experience.
  • Previous experience in cybersecurity startups or high-growth SaaS environments.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role will be measured by your ability to:

  • Deliver successful enterprise integrations and deployments.
  • Reduce customer time-to-production.
  • Build reliable and scalable ingestion solutions.
  • Improve customer adoption and technical satisfaction.
  • Resolve complex integration challenges efficiently.
  • Turn customer-specific requirements into reusable platform capabilities.
  • Contribute improvements that strengthen the scalability and flexibility of the core product.

What Darwoft Offers

  • Contractor agreement with payment in USD
  • 100% remote work
  • Argentina's public holidays
  • English classes
  • Referral program
  • Access to learning platforms

  • Supervisar los trabajos de contratistas y gestionar los requisitos de Permit to Work (PTW) relacionados con actividades de integridad, tales como reparaciones metalúrgicas y de reacondicionamiento, modificaciones en tanques, recipientes y ductos, preparación de superficies y aplicación de recubrimientos, protección catódica y actividades de control de corrosión.

  • Título técnico en disciplinas Mecánicas, Industriales, Metalúrgicas o afines, o experiencia de campo equivalente y relevante.
  • Mínimo 5 años de experiencia en asset integrity, inspección, mantenimiento, construcción o actividades relacionadas dentro de la industria de Oil & Gas.
  • Experiencia en reparación de tanques conforme a API 653, Non-Destructive Testing (NDT), protección catódica, instalación de piping y actividades de construcción.
  • Conocimiento de los estándares técnicos aplicables (API/NACE).

  • Nivel de inglés intermedio.
  • Título de Ingeniería.
  • Certificaciones API y/o NACE.

  • Esta posición opera bajo un esquema rotacional 7x7 en el yacimiento El Trapial.
  • Durante la rotación, la persona seleccionada se alojará en el Chevron Camp.

No se considerarán asignaciones de expatriados.

About the Project

We are partnering with an innovative cybersecurity company building a next-generation Identity Security and Identity Observability platform .

The product helps enterprise security teams understand how human users, service accounts, workloads, applications, and AI-driven identities access systems across cloud, SaaS, network, endpoint, and on-premise environments .

At the core of the platform is a highly data-intensive architecture that collects and analyzes large volumes of events, logs, network telemetry, identity activity, and security signals . This information is processed to identify unusual access patterns, security risks, identity blind spots, infrastructure misconfigurations, and potential threats.

The platform integrates with complex enterprise ecosystems including identity providers, cloud platforms, SASE solutions, SIEMs, endpoint security tools, network infrastructure, and security services.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer focused on Data Ingestion, Integrations, and Collectors to become a key technical bridge between enterprise customers and the engineering organization.

This is not a traditional backend or internal data engineering position.

You’ll work directly with customers to understand their infrastructure, data sources, security architecture, network topology, APIs, and workflows, then design and implement scalable mechanisms to ingest that information into the platform.

You’ll combine data engineering, software engineering, solution architecture, cloud infrastructure, and technical consulting .

A major part of your mission will be building and evolving connectors and ingestion pipelines capable of integrating data from complex enterprise environments while maintaining reliability, scalability, security, and fast time‑to‑production.

title: Quality & Partnerships Lead, FE Colleges (Liverpool)
description:
• Location: Liverpool City Region, working across our partner colleges and from home.
  • Working pattern: Hybrid model combining c.3-4 days per week on site at local partner colleges with the rest of the week working from home.
  • Travel: Regular local travel between partner colleges, with occasional travel to other regions for team meetings and offsites.
  • Salary: £44,000 pa
  • Contract: Permanent, full-time (40 hours per week).
    Standard working hours are 9:00 am to 6:00 pm (with a 1-hour unpaid lunch break).
  • We offer flexibility to employees to balance their commitments, including medical appointments, parental or caregiving responsibilities, and personal goals.

Key relationships

  • internal: Head of Quality; Head of Learner Progress; Business Development Lead, FE & Public Sector; Quality & Partnerships Leads in other regions; Admissions, Talent, Employer Partnerships and Safeguarding teams.
  • external: FE colleges, including senior leaders and programme delivery teams.

Closing date: 27 November 2026. Early applications are encouraged.

ABOUT THE ROLE
Generation is increasingly delivering its programmes in partnership with Further Education (FE) colleges. Each college's own instructors and support staff run the course day to day, while Generation provides the curriculum, training and quality assurance, and helps learners into jobs. Our college partners run programmes across a growing range of sectors, including healthcare, tech and green.

We are looking for an experienced education professional with a background in FE who can (i) build lasting partnerships with FE colleges, and (ii) make sure the Generation programmes they deliver are high quality and lead to strong job outcomes.
This is a key role at the heart of how we grow this work, reporting into the Learning team leadership.

  • Partnerships: once a new college partner has signed up with Generation, you will lead the day-to-day relationship. You will build positive, productive relationships at every level of the college - from senior leaders to the instructors and Learner Progress Coaches delivering the programme. You will plan cohorts (groups of learners) with each college, keep the partnership on track and help colleges take on more of the delivery over time.
  • Quality: you will onboard, train and coach college staff to deliver a high-quality programme at every stage, from admissions through the bootcamp and into work. Using observation and learner data, you will quality assure delivery against Generation's standards, working with colleges to address issues early and escalating where needed.

You will typically oversee several cohorts at different stages at the same time: some preparing to start, some on the bootcamp and some moving into jobs.

This role is a strong fit for someone who builds trusted relationships easily, enjoys coaching educators and cares deeply about quality - and who never loses sight of what matters most: learners progressing into good jobs.

ABOUT GENERATION

Generation is a charity with the vision of a meaningful career for every person. Our aim is to support people facing significant and multiple barriers to employment into life-changing careers they otherwise could not access.

We achieve this with a unique methodology of profession-specific skills bootcamp training, focussed on in-demand careers (specifically in the tech, healthcare and green sectors), with extensive, ongoing pastoral support and matchmaking to employer partners.

Generation launched globally in 2015, and has grown quickly to become the world’s largest demand-led employment initiative. We have placed >100,000 people into roles, working with over 4,000 employer partners to date across 16 countries and 26 professions.

Since launching in the UK in 2019 have now trained more than 3500 people. Our work focuses on supporting those from diverse groups facing barriers to desirable employment. For these learners, we have achieved an industry leading c. 70% job placement rate with learners now placed at >800 employers.

We have secured transformative corporate funding from Microsoft, the JP Morgan Charitable Foundation, the Macquarie Group Foundation, Barclays, Blackrock, and many more. We are also the leading charity delivering under contracts from the Department for Education’s Skills Bootcamp strand. This has driven our scale to new programmes, regions and beneficiary groups.

By joining Generation UK&I, you will become part of an organisation committed to social impact and determined to play its part in changing the system in this context. The work is fast-paced, exciting, and innovative.

Find out more at

And you can hear more about our impact from our learners and beneficiaries themselves

And you can also learn more about our culture, directly from our incredible people on our website:

Generation acknowledges the duty of care to safeguard, protect, and promote the welfare of staff and learners and is committed to ensuring safeguarding practice reflects statutory responsibilities, and government guidance and complies with best practice. We carry out employment and right-to-work checks, and request a declaration of any criminal convictions from all staff as part of our recruitment process.

RESPONSIBILITIES

The role has two parts. First, you will lead the day-to-day relationship with each college – building positive, productive relationships, planning cohorts together and running regular meetings and reviews to keep the partnership on track. Second, at each stage of the programme – admissions, the bootcamp and placement – you will onboard, train and coach college staff. You will use observation and learner data to quality assure their delivery against Generation's standards, working with colleges to address issues early and escalating where needed.

1. College Partnership Management (c.30%)

  • Be the day-to-day contact for your partner colleges, building strong working relationships with senior leaders and delivery teams, and coordinating support from Generation's specialist teams.
  • Coordinate annual delivery planning with each college, including the number and timing of cohorts, and act as their link to Generation's Fundraising & Operations team on growing the partnership.
  • Track each college's readiness in the run-up to every cohort – including staffing, learner recruitment, facilities and data – through regular check-ins, and work with the college to resolve issues where things are off track.
  • Run regular partnership meetings, end-of-cohort reviews and an annual partnership review, tracking performance against agreed outcomes and agreeing actions together.

2. Admissions: Support & Quality Assurance (c.15%)

  • Support colleges to plan and deliver recruitment of the learners our programmes are designed for – people facing barriers to employment – project managing progress against agreed milestones.
  • Train college staff on Generation's admissions process and selection criteria, and support them as they take on more of it over time.
  • Quality assure assessment and selection decisions, including taking part in selection meetings, so that admissions meets Generation's standards and funding requirements.

3. Bootcamp: Delivery Support & Quality Assurance (c.30%)

  • Support colleges to recruit instructors and Learner Progress Coaches (who provide pastoral and employability support for learners), including taking part in interviews.
  • Lead the onboarding of new instructors and Learner Progress Coaches, so they are ready to deliver the Generation programme with confidence.
  • Provide hands-on support during a college's first cohorts, co-facilitating sessions and modelling Generation's teaching approach.
  • Observe teaching and learner support against Generation's quality framework, giving actionable feedback and coaching, and agreeing improvement plans with college staff where needed.
  • Facilitate a community of practice where college delivery staff share what works and solve problems together.
  • Act as the escalation point for learner, quality and safeguarding concerns, and support delivery teams to meet diverse learner needs.

4. Placement: Support, Quality Assurance & Employment Outcomes (c.15%)

  • In the final weeks of a bootcamp, plan each cohort's move into the placement phase with college staff and Generation's Talent team, so learners are ready to find, apply for and secure jobs.
  • Quality assure the college's support for learners during placement, including in-person job clubs and keeping learners engaged, and act early where employment outcomes are at risk.
  • Connect Generation's Employer Partnerships team with the right people in each college so they can develop employer opportunities together.

5. Data-Led Quality & Continuous Improvement (c.10%)

  • Lead weekly cohort meetings with instructors and Learner Progress Coaches, using learner data to spot issues early and agree actions.
  • Support colleges to keep learner, delivery and outcomes data accurate and up to date, and report on trends and risks across your colleges.
  • Share what works across your colleges to strengthen Generation's college partnership model.

Your Development

Generation is growing the number of programmes it delivers with FE colleges, and our Quality & Partnerships Leads will shape how we do this together. You will:

  • Be part of a community of practice with Quality & Partnerships Leads in other regions, sharing practice and solving problems together.
  • Receive training from Generation's specialist teams and gain first-hand experience of the programmes Generation delivers itself.
  • Receive regular coaching and feedback to develop your own practice.

Requirements

ABOUT YOU

  • Relationship-builder: you build positive, long-term relationships with college leaders and delivery staff alike, and you're comfortable having honest conversations when something is off track.
  • Quality-focused coach: you help instructors and support staff improve their practice through observation, feedback and coaching – across a range of subjects, not just your own specialism – and you hold high standards for learners.
  • Organised programme manager: you plan ahead and keep several cohorts, colleges and deadlines moving at once.
  • Data-driven: you use learner and performance data to spot risks early and drive improvement.
  • Collaborative influencer: you get things done through people you don't line manage, inside and outside Generation.
  • Mission-aligned: you're passionate about creating opportunities for people facing barriers to work, and committed to improving your own practice.

Essential experience

  • Experience working in, or closely with, the Further Education (FE) sector.
  • Experience in teaching, training or education delivery, including coaching or developing instructors, teachers or facilitators.
  • Leadership or management experience, including leading quality assurance and continuous improvement in education, training or employability programmes.
  • Experience building and managing relationships with external partners, such as colleges or training providers.
  • Working knowledge of safeguarding requirements in education.
  • Experience supporting learners from diverse or disadvantaged backgrounds.

Strongly desired

  • Experience of publicly funded provision, such as Skills Bootcamps, Adult Skills Fund programmes or apprenticeships.
  • Experience of learner recruitment, assessment or selection.
  • Experience of employability programmes or supporting learners into work.

    If you meet only some of these criteria, but believe you have transferable skills and experience, we would still strongly welcome your application.

Benefits

At Generation, we're changing the lives of many individuals, and that in itself gets us out of bed! Here are a few other benefits you'll experience working with the UK team:

  • Purpose and social impact in the heart of your work
  • Opportunity to make your mark - you'll have a lot of autonomy to bring the Generation blueprint to life in a way that makes sense for your region
  • Opportunity to get involved with a range of activities and varied projects - we're a small team, so there are lots of opportunities to get involved in projects across the whole organisation
  • We offer flexible and remote working to accommodate everyone's preferred working pattern/preferences and unique needs
  • WFH set up offer of support of £300 to help you make your working-from-home setup comfortable and efficient
  • Professional Development is a priority for Generation and employees and you can access to up to £1,000 towards your learning & development per year. This support is accompanied by up to 5 days of training days/ study leave per year to enable your development activities.


About the process

  • Stage 1: Upload your CV and answer three questions about your motivation for the role and relevant skills.
  • Stage 2: Virtual interview
  • Stage 3: Task and interview (in person)
  • Stage 4 (optional): Final check in case of a tie, or to confirm values alignment with another team member
  • Deadline for applications: 27 November 2026

A fair chance

Every role at Generation is open to applications from all sections of society. We believe in the potential of everyone; regardless of race, religion or belief, ethnic origin, different physical ability, family structure, socio-economics, age, nationality or citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other aspect that makes you, well, you.

We believe that the more diverse we are the better we become. More than just encouraging your application, we're committed to conscious inclusion that (we hope) cultivates an ethos of belonging, connection and shared purpose. We go further together. It’s this philosophy that drives us towards our mission. We open our doors to those who share this mindset.

We are particularly interested in hearing from candidates from marginalised groups. We will assess applications on a rolling basis and close this posting as soon as we have found the right candidate. We look forward to hearing from you.

We enable digital businesses to scale with high performance and reliability by providing connectivity, IP Transit, private networks, data centers, bare metal, and cloud solutions to ISPs, content providers, hyperscalers, and global technology companies.

Through our own infrastructure platform and strategic interconnection with major global hubs and content networks, we bring content closer to end users and deliver low latency, security, and operational resilience across the Americas and beyond.

Role Overview

The Data Center Engineer is responsible for the operational health of EdgeUno's colocation facilities, primarily the Points of Presence (POPs) in Querétaro and Guadalajara, Mexico. The role combines hands on installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of IT and network infrastructure with planning, documentation, and coordination of deployment activities, supporting the reliability and security standards required by a 24x7 infrastructure environment.

About the Role

This position sits inside EdgeUno's regional infrastructure operations, working directly with racks, cabling, servers, network devices, and facility systems inside the data center. The engineer coordinates with internal teams on deployments, asset tracking, and capacity planning, and supports incident response and maintenance windows as needed. The role requires physical, hands on work (equipment installation, cabling, hardware handling) and may require availability outside standard business hours depending on operational demands.

Core ResponsibilitiesEquipment Installation and Maintenance
  • Rack, stack, and cable IT equipment, including servers, network devices, firewalls, and rPDUs.
  • Implement and maintain structured cable management best practices.
  • Commission and decommission equipment.
  • Assist with the deployment of rack and Meet Me Room (MMR) cabling, ensuring high quality standards.
  • Perform Layer 1 and basic Layer 2 troubleshooting for servers and network devices.
Infrastructure and Facility Management
  • Maintain and update the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS).
  • Support Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) activities, including asset tracking and capacity documentation.
  • Ensure cleanliness, organization, and proper operational standards within the data center environment.
  • Conduct physical audits of data center assets and infrastructure.
  • Manage and keep updated warehouse, device, and optic spares.
IT Equipment Handling and Security
  • Securely decommission IT equipment, including removal of Data Bearing Devices (DBDs) and preparation for secure destruction.
  • Execute hard drive shredding procedures according to company security policies.
  • Move locked DBD bins to designated shredding areas.
  • Support audit and inventory management processes.
Operational Support
  • Perform basic troubleshooting and documented repairs on servers and IT equipment.
  • Support fiber and connectivity troubleshooting activities when required.
  • Execute rack relocations and equipment movements across company locations when necessary.
  • Provide support during infrastructure incidents, maintenance windows, and emergency situations.
Planning and Coordination
  • Support planning and coordination of infrastructure deployments and equipment installations.
  • Maintain accurate documentation related to racks, cabling, assets, and deployments.
  • Assist with infrastructure capacity planning and operational improvements across EdgeUno data center locations.
Requirements
  • Hands on experience in data center operations or infrastructure environments.
  • Experience with incident response, troubleshooting, and operational problem solving.
  • Understanding of data center infrastructure fundamentals, including power, cooling, cabling, and physical security.
  • Ability to work in a hands on environment handling servers, cabling, and hardware equipment.
  • Availability to support a 24x7 infrastructure environment when operational needs arise.
  • Willingness to travel occasionally between EdgeUno locations.
  • English proficiency, B2 level minimum.
Nice to Have
  • Basic Linux server administration.
  • Scripting or automation experience (PowerShell, Python, or similar).
  • Experience with network monitoring tools.
  • Basic networking knowledge and troubleshooting skills.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure deployments.
  • Experience with fiber connectivity troubleshooting and OTDR analysis.
  • Relevant industry certifications, such as CCNA, AWS, Google Cloud, or similar.
What We Offer
  • Opportunity to work directly with EdgeUno's regional infrastructure platform supporting high performance connectivity across Latin America.
  • Hands on exposure to large scale data center operations and network infrastructure.
  • Collaborative, multicultural, and execution focused work environment.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.

title: DIRECTOR OF OPERATIONS/SECURITY (Sunnyside)
description:
Director of Operation

The Operations/Security Director is responsible for overseeing the daily operations, security functions, and facilities management of a DHS long-term shelter site. This includes ensuring full compliance with DHS, FDNY, DOHMH, OSHA, and other city and state regulations. The Director will lead the operations and security teams, supervise vendors, manage facility systems, and ensure a safe, clean, and secure environment for all residents and staff.

This position is 100% dedicated to the project, requires 35 hours per week (with flexibility), and the Director must be on-call 24 hours a day, 7 days a week for emergencies related to operations and safety.

Key Responsibilities:

Operations Oversight

1. Supervise facility and program operations staff; manage and oversee external vendors and contractors.

2. Collaborate with the Site Director to meet contractual obligations and program goals in alignment with DHS standards.

3. Partner with senior management for preparation of proposals, audits, and programmatic reports.

4. Develop and implement operational goals, procedures, and emergency protocols tailored to the shelter environment.

5. Conduct monthly facility inspections and walk-throughs to assess the condition of shelter infrastructure and systems (e.g., HVAC, plumbing, electrical).

6. Ensure proper function and documentation of the work order/ticketing system.

7. Maintain accurate operations logs, inventories, records, and forms.

8. Oversee procurement processes, inventory control, and tracking of supplies, furnishings, and equipment.

9. Negotiate service contracts and lease terms related to facility operations.

10. Ensure timely renewal of all licenses and permits from FDNY, DOB, DOHMH, and other regulatory agencies.

11. Assist with DHS inspections and respond promptly to any compliance findings.

Compliance & Safety

12. Enforce adherence to OSHA standards, DHS facility requirements, and Universal Precautions policies.

13. Coordinate fire drills, facility evacuations, and maintain emergency response readiness.

14. Monitor and ensure staff compliance with fire safety and security certifications (e.g., F-80, OSHA).

15. Serve as point of contact for operational emergencies including building systems failures, fire alarms, and unsafe conditions. Staff Supervision & Development

16. Recruit, supervise, and evaluate operations and security personnel; ensure completion of required training and certifications.

17. Develop work schedules, assignments, and staffing plans to maintain 24/7 coverage.

18. Maintain positive labor relations and liaise with unions as needed.

19. Support the professional development of team members through mentoring, training, and supervision.

Security Oversight

20. Supervise and coordinate all aspects of site security operations, ensuring safety of residents, staff, and visitors.

21. Develop, implement, and update security policies, patrol routines, and safety procedures.

22. Respond to and investigate incidents, safety infractions, and breaches; prepare incident reports for DHS and internal tracking.

23. Ensure timely and accurate maintenance of security logs and incident records.

24. Coordinate with NYPD, FDNY, and other emergency responders as necessary.

25. Provide coverage and assist with security operations when staffing shortages arise.

Community & External Relations

26. Represent the shelter and operations function at meetings with city agencies, community boards, and partner organizations.

27. Foster positive relationships with the community while ensuring facility safety and compliance.

Required Qualifications:

· Bachelor’s degree preferred in facilities management, public administration, business, or related field.

· Minimum 5–7 years of facilities or operations management experience, preferably in a residential, shelter, or social services setting.

· Valid New York State Security Guard License.

· FDNY F-80 Certificate of Fitness (or ability to obtain within 30 days).

· OSHA Certification preferred.

· Valid NYS Driver’s License, if authorized to operate an agency vehicle.

· Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and facility management systems.

· Knowledge of NYC shelter systems, DHS requirements, and building operations.

· Experience supervising diverse teams and managing in unionized environments.

· Strong organizational, written, and verbal communication skills.

· Ability to respond to emergencies and make sound decisions under pressure.

· Must be able to travel to offsite meetings and training throughout New York City.

· Must be able to ascend/descend stairs in the assigned shelter facility.

· Must be on call 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

Country Overview

Argentina: Building Our Presence

Bechtel is building a strong local organization in Argentina, partnering with industry, government, suppliers, and communities to support our customers and projects. We're bringing global expertise to develop local talent, strengthen regional capabilities, and deliver lasting value - establishing a trusted, long-term presence that supports sustainable growth and positions Argentina as a cornerstone market for mining, energy, and infrastructure development.

Job Summary

Manage the obtaining, maintenance and monitoring of environmental and sectoral permits that enable the execution of the project in Argentina, ensuring that the engineering design, constructive planning and field activities comply with the applicable national and provincial regulations, with the commitments assumed before the authority and with the environmental standards of the client.

The position acts as a bridge between engineering and the regulatory authority: it translates the legal requirements into verifiable design criteria, anticipates the environmental restrictions that condition the layout and the construction sequence, and maintains a critical permit route aligned with the project schedule. Its performance is measured by the absence of regulatory detentions and by the technical quality of the information presented to the competent bodies.

Major Responsibilities

  • Permission management
    Preparing and keeping updated the project permits matrix, identifying competent body, submission requirements, legal deadlines and actual processing deadlines.
  • Prepare, review and submit the Environmental Impact Report and its biennial updates, along with the supporting technical documentation required by the provincial mining authority.
  • Managing the associated sectoral permits: water use and concession, effluent dumping, emissions into the atmosphere, hazardous waste management, soil movement, intervention of native vegetation and transport of hazardous substances.
  • Maintaining technical dialogue with provincial and national enforcement authorities, responding to observations, requests for additional information and audits.
  • Timely alert the permits that constitute a critical route and propose sequencing alternatives when a regulatory deadline compromises the schedule.

Environmental studies and assessment

  • Defining the scope of the environmental baselines - air quality, noise, surface and groundwater, soils, flora, fauna, glaciers and periglacial environment, archaeology and socio-economic environment - and technically supervise the consulting firms that execute them.
  • Reviewing consultant deliverables verifying methodological sufficiency, representativeness of sampling and traceability of data before its incorporation into the file.
  • Evaluating environmental impacts of the project, propose mitigation and compensation measures, and verify that they are reflected in the design criteria and technical specifications.
  • Estimating hours, costs and deadlines of environmental studies for their incorporation into the project budget and program.

Compliance, monitoring and interface with the project

  • Keeping track of environmental commitments derived from the Environmental Impact Statement and the permits granted, and periodically verify their compliance on the ground.
  • Providing the engineering disciplines with the environmental constraints applicable to the design - layout restrictions, exclusion areas, discharge limits and water management criteria - and verify their incorporation.
  • Preparing progress reports on the status of permits for the client and for the project management, with status, regulatory risks and mitigation actions.
  • Supporting the processes of citizen participation and relations with communities and local authorities, in coordination with the social area of the project and the client.
  • Issuing the environmental deliverables under the project's documentary control system, respecting the review scheme and the preparation, review and approval signatures.

Regulatory framework of reference

Dominating the Argentine environmental regime and its federal articulation: the Nation sets the minimum protection budgets and the provinces, as holders of the original domain of natural resources, are the enforcement authority that grants the permits. The following list is the minimum core required: Law 25.675, Law 24.585; Law 26.639; Law 24.051, Law 25.688, Law 26.331, Law 25.743, Law 25.831, Law 27.520, ILO Convention 169 (Law 24.071).

Education and Experience Requirements

Level 1

  • Requires a university degree in Environmental Sciences, Chemistry, Civil Engineering, Natural Resources, Geological Sciences or Biological Sciences, with professional registration in the corresponding jurisdiction, between 5 and 8 years of professional practice in environmental management and permits, with at least 3 years in mining, energy or infrastructure projects in Argentina.
  • A graduate degree, major or diploma in environmental management, environmental impact assessment or environmental law is desirable.

Level 2

  • Requires a university degree in Environmental Sciences, Chemistry, Civil Engineering, Natural Resources, Geological Sciences or Biological Sciences, with professional registration in the corresponding jurisdiction, between 8 and 10 years of professional practice in environmental management and permits, with at least 5 years in mining, energy or infrastructure projects in Argentina.
  • A graduate degree, major or diploma in environmental management, environmental impact assessment or environmental law is desirable.

Required Knowledge and Skills

  • Verifiable participation in at least one complete cycle of environmental processing: preparation of the study, submission to the authority, response to observations and obtaining the approving resolution.
  • Experience in direct interaction with provincial and national public agencies, and in technical supervision of environmental consultancies.
  • Previous experience in EPC or EPCM environments is desirable, with exposure to document control, change control and management of interfaces between disciplines. Mastery of the Argentine environmental regime described in the previous section and ability to track its provincial regulations.
  • Environmental impact assessment methodologies, design of monitoring plans and environmental management programs; notions of modeling of air quality, noise and dispersion of pollutants.
  • Management of geographic information systems, advanced spreadsheets and project scheduling tools.
  • Native Spanish and intermediate or higher technical English, sufficient to read international standards and participate in meetings with multinational teams.
  • The Documentary Organization: Maintains complete, versioned and auditable files at all times.
  • Integrity: Does not sign or endorse information that it cannot endorse, even under deadline pressure.
  • The technical rigor: Supports each statement of the file in verifiable data and detects methodological weaknesses in third-party studies.
  • Regulatory anticipation: Identifies the permit that will become a critical route before it becomes one and activates management well in advance.
  • The institutional communication: Maintains a professional and traceable relationship with the authority; writes with legal and technical precision.
  • The transversal work: Translates environmental requirements into the language of engineering and negotiates solutions with the disciplines without compromising compliance.
  • Experience in metallic and/or non-metallic mining.
  • Experience in EPC/EPCM projects and knowledge of the AACE standard.
  • Knowledge of local design regulations.

For decades, Bechtel has worked to inspire the next generation of engineers and beyond! Because our teams face some of the world's toughest challenges, we offer robust benefits to ensure our people thrive. Whether it is advancing careers, delivering programs to enhance our culture, or providing time to recharge, Bechtel has the benefits to build a legacy of sustainable growth.
