About Us

Proofpoint is a global leader in human- and agent-centric cybersecurity. We protect how people, data, and AI agents connect across email, cloud, and collaboration tools. Over 80 of the Fortune 100, 10,000 large enterprises, and millions of smaller organizations trust Proofpoint to stop threats, prevent data loss, and build resilience across their people and AI workflows. Our mission is simple: safeguard the digital world and empower people to work securely and confidently. Join us in our pursuit to defend data and protect people.

How We Work

At Proofpoint you'll be part of a global team that breaks barriers to redefine cybersecurity guided by our BRAVE core values:

  • Bold in how we dream and innovate
  • Responsive to feedback, challenges and opportunities
  • Accountable for results and best in class outcomes
  • Visionary in future focused problem-solving
  • Exceptional in execution and impact

Position Overview

Proofpoint is seeking a DevOps and Data Engineer to join our Data Platform team. This is a hybrid role that sits at the intersection of platform engineering and data infrastructure—you will own the reliability, automation, and delivery of the systems that power Proofpoint's data pipelines and analytics capabilities. You will build and maintain the cloud infrastructure (AWS‑first), CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps tooling that enable data engineering teams to ship high‑quality data products faster and more safely. At the same time, you will actively contribute to the design and operation of data pipelines using AWS Glue, Athena, and S3, bringing a strong operational mindset to data engineering. If you thrive at the boundary between platform and data, love automating toil, and care deeply about reliability and developer experience, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

  • Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or equivalent) for automated testing, deployment, and promotion of AWS Glue ETL jobs, Athena views, and related data infrastructure.
  • Build and manage cloud infrastructure on AWS using Infrastructure‑as‑Code (Terraform and/or AWS CDK)—covering S3 buckets, IAM roles, Glue resources, Athena workgroups, Lake Formation permissions, VPCs, and supporting services.
  • Own the observability stack for data pipelines: define and instrument metrics, logs, and alerts (CloudWatch, Datadog, or equivalent) to ensure SLA compliance and fast incident response.
  • Develop and maintain the DataOps platform‑self‑service tooling, pipeline templates, and shared libraries that allow data engineers to spin up production‑grade pipelines quickly.
  • Manage container and compute infrastructure (Docker, ECS/EKS, or Lambda) used to support data ingestion microservices and orchestration workers.
  • Design and operate workflow orchestration environments (Amazon MWAA / Apache Airflow, AWS Step Functions) including upgrades, scaling, and reliability hardening.
  • Build and maintain AWS Glue ETL jobs (PySpark) for large‑scale data ingestion and transformation across the data lake on S3.
  • Drive security best practices across the data platform: secrets management (AWS Secrets Manager / Parameter Store), least‑privilege IAM, network segmentation, and compliance controls.
  • Collaborate with data engineers, data scientists, and security teams to translate requirements into scalable, automated infrastructure solutions.
  • Lead incident response for data platform outages: on‑call participation, root‑cause analysis, and post‑mortem‑driven improvements.
  • Mentor junior engineers on DevOps and data engineering practices, conduct code and design reviews, and contribute to architecture decision records.

What You Bring to the Team

Required

  • 5+ years of professional experience in DevOps, platform engineering, or site reliability engineering, with at least 2 years of hands‑on data engineering work.
  • Deep expertise with AWS core services: S3, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch, Lambda, ECS/EKS, Secrets Manager, and CloudFormation/CDK.
  • Hands‑on experience with AWS data services: Glue (ETL jobs, Crawlers, Data Catalog), Athena (workgroup management, query tuning, federated queries), and S3 (lifecycle, encryption, event notifications).
  • Proficiency with Infrastructure‑as‑Code tools—Terraform and/or AWS CDK—for managing production cloud environments.
  • Strong CI/CD experience: designing and maintaining pipelines in GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent.
  • Experience with container technologies (Docker) and container orchestration (Amazon ECS, EKS, or Kubernetes).
  • Proven ability to design and operate observability systems (metrics, logging, distributed tracing, alerting) for data and platform services.
  • Strong communication skills—able to translate operational concerns into clear engineering trade‑offs for both technical and non‑technical audiences.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with real‑time / streaming data processing using Apache Kafka, Amazon Kinesis, or Glue Streaming ETL.
  • Knowledge of data quality frameworks (Great Expectations, Deequ, or similar) and experience integrating them into CI/CD.
  • Familiarity with open table formats (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake) and lakehouse patterns.
  • Background in cybersecurity, threat intelligence, or security‑data analytics environments.
  • AWS Certified DevOps Engineer - Professional, AWS Certified Data Engineer - Associate, or AWS Certified Solutions Architect certification.
  • Experience with cost optimization tooling (Infracost, AWS Cost Explorer dashboards, Athena query cost governance).

Why Proofpoint?

At Proofpoint, we believe that an exceptional career experience includes a comprehensive compensation and benefits package. Here are just a few reasons you'll love working with us:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Comprehensive benefits
  • Career success on your terms
  • Flexible work environment
  • Annual wellness and community outreach days
  • Always on recognition for your contributions
  • Global collaboration and networking opportunities

Our Culture

Our culture is rooted in values that inspire belonging, empower purpose and drive success—every day, for everyone.

We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to support and execute a critical observability migration. In this role, you will lead the transition of our application and infrastructure telemetry from New Relic to a modern, OpenTelemetry (OTel) Collector-based architecture. You will be responsible for re-instrumenting applications, updating infrastructure manifests, validating telemetry outputs, and ensuring seamless monitoring coverage across our high-scale ecosystem without compromising operational visibility.

Key Responsibilities

  • Migrate existing application instrumentation, tracing, and telemetry configurations from New Relic to OpenTelemetry.
  • Update YAML configuration files, environment variables, and deployment manifests according to established architecture standards.
  • Execute unit tests and validation suites to verify that telemetry is accurately generated, transformed, and exported to target backends.
  • Perform telemetry gap analysis, comparing existing New Relic data against OTel outputs to identify missing traces, metrics, logs, or resource attributes.
  • Assist in updating dashboards, monitoring documentation, and troubleshooting guides to reflect the OTel architecture.
  • Investigate telemetry collection and export errors, identifying root causes and collaborating with core platform engineers on complex edge cases.
  • Maintain clear tracking and reporting of implementation progress, edge cases, and potential migration risks.

Requirements

Must-Have:

  • Proven experience in software engineering with proficiency in at least one modern language (Java, Python, Go, or JavaScript/TypeScript).
  • Hands-on experience with OpenTelemetry (OTel) concepts, including distributed tracing, metrics, logs, and OTel Collector configurations.
  • Deep experience with cloud observability paradigms and transitioning off legacy platforms like New Relic.
  • Solid understanding of APIs, environment-based configurations, and reading/modifying complex YAML/JSON manifests.
  • Strong background in software testing, debugging log analysis, and validating high-cardinality telemetry data.
  • Familiarity with modern software delivery workflows (Git, PRs, CI/CD pipelines).

Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience operating or configuring OTel Collectors in Kubernetes or containerized environments.
  • Knowledge of FinOps and cost-optimization strategies related to telemetry ingestion rates.

Key Deliverables & Success Criteria

  • Execution: Successfully updated application instrumentation, validated OTel Collector configs, and verified end-to-end telemetry delivery to designated backends.
  • Documentation: Updated technical documentation, migration checklists, and runbooks.
  • Quality & Continuity: Zero removal of critical monitoring coverage during the migration window, with all pull requests passing automated tests and code reviews.

title: Head of European Partner Engagement and Research
description:
Candidates should expect to travel to the selected city for monthly in-person meetups.

ROLE SUMMARY

The Head of Europe will join PAI's international department to lead the organization's engagement and research within the European AI ecosystem. Reporting directly to the Managing Director, International this role will set and lead PAI's engagement and research strategy in Europe by deepening relationships with existing partners and stakeholders, identifying and cultivating new partnerships, and leading convenings, meetings, and brainstorms with key stakeholders across industry, civil society, and academia. The role will lead the development of guidance and research outputs that align PAI's global programmatic priorities with issues of direct relevance and resonance in the region.

Beyond its European focus, the role also carries a broader international component. The Head of Europe will partner with the Managing Director, International in implementing PAI's international strategy, including the potential launch of new PAI hubs in new regions and engagement with non-Western stakeholders, including in the Global South.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Stakeholder Engagement & Partnership Development (Est. time: 30%)

  • Serve as PAI’s primary point of contact and relationship-builder in Europe, reinforcing the organization’s role as a bridge between sectors and geographies.
  • Deepen and sustain relationships with PAI’s existing partners and stakeholders across Europe, including industry, civil society, academia, and government, in collaboration with the Programs & Research and Policy teams.
  • Identify new strategic and meaningful partners in Europe, that expands PAI reach and multistakeholder community.
  • In cooperation with the Partnership Development team, identify, cultivate, and engage new strategic partners in Europe who expand PAI’s reach and multistakeholder community and advance its mission in the region.
  • Working with the Director of Development, identify and pursue European funding opportunities (including foundations, philanthropic organizations, corporate partners), and contribute to proposals and strategic fundraising tied to PAI’s European events and initiatives.

Convenings & Coordination (Est. time: 20%)

  • Drive activities to convene and support PAI’s European Steering Committee (including preparation of position papers and agendas).
  • Contribute to other relevant related committees in Europe, such as the Policy Steering Committee, by participating in their convenings and virtual events, and by providing feedback and suggestions on their composition and outputs, ensuring complementarity and cross-pollination.
  • Design, organize, and host convenings, meetings, and brainstorms with key partners and stakeholders.
  • Oversee logistics and substantive content for European events, ensuring they reflect PAI's multi-stakeholder approach and mission.
  • Represent PAI at relevant European conferences, working groups, and policy forums.

Research & Guidance Development (Est. time: 30%)

  • Identify and scope emerging, high-impact, and time-sensitive topics for PAI’s research in Europe.
  • Lead the development of guidance and research outputs aligned with PAI's global programmatic priorities, with direct relevance and resonance for the European region. Work closely with members of the Programs & Research as well as Policy teams to deliver this goal.
  • Working with the Communications team, author and co-author research papers, blogs, and op-eds in collaboration with PAI staff and Partners that build visibility around PAI research and engagement in Europe.
  • Contribute European perspectives and expertise to PAI's global research agenda.

Cross-Departmental Collaboration & Broader International Strategy (Est. time: 20%)

  • Work closely with internal PAI departments to ensure European insights inform global programmatic and research priorities.
  • Partner with the Managing Director, International in implementing PAI's international strategy, including the potential launch of new regional hubs.
  • Support engagement with non-Western stakeholders, including in the Global South, and represent PAI at international convenings.

Other

  • This role requires flexibility to work extended or later hours one to two days per week to accommodate meetings with colleagues in U.S. time zones, ensuring overlap with Eastern and Pacific working hours.
  • The position also involves travel of approximately 20% of the time, both within Europe and internationally, including to North America and Africa.
  • The list of responsibilities set out are not exhaustive It may be necessary to adapt tasks within the scope of the role as needed.


WHO YOU ARE / WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • Masters degree or higher in related discipline or equivalent (7-10 years) work experience required.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively across a distributed, international team.
  • A strong team player, who is able to work across the organization, and coordinate between teams when designing/delivering work.
  • Significant professional experience in AI policy, governance, technology partnerships, or a related field, with a demonstrated understanding of the European AI ecosystem.
  • Proven track record of building and managing relationships with senior stakeholders across industry, civil society, academia, and/or government.
  • Experience designing and leading convenings, working groups, or multi-stakeholder initiatives.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex, multi-stakeholder input into clear guidance and research outputs.
  • Fluency in English required; additional European languages a plus.
  • Willingness to travel across Europe as needed for convenings and stakeholder meetings


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Ability to navigate a small yet complex institution
  • Willingness to participate constructively on organizational priorities beyond the immediate focus of their work
  • Existing network of relationships with European AI policymakers, civil society organizations, and industry leaders.
  • Familiarity with PAI's mission, programmatic work, and multi-stakeholder model.
  • Experience contributing to or authoring research or guidance documents on AI governance topics.
  • Comfort with institutional change and periods of ambiguity

QUALITIES THAT ARE IMPORTANT TO US:

  • Justice: Notices and addresses inequities, includes diverse perspectives, and acts fairly in decisions and collaboration.
  • Trust: Communicates openly, follows through on commitments, and demonstrates reliability and integrity.
  • Respect: Listens fully, values others’ time and contributions, and collaborates thoughtfully.
  • Compassion: Shows empathy, patience, and care, especially when supporting colleagues or navigating challenges.


ADDITIONAL INFORMATION


We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if you don't meet every qualification listed. What matters most is your commitment to PAI’s mission and the potential you bring. We are actively interested in building a diverse pool of candidates and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.


Compensation

PAI’s compensation philosophy reflects our commitment to fairness and equity across our distributed team. Compensation is based on role level, experience, skills, geographic location, and internal equity.


The compensation range for this role depends on where you are based:

  • London, UK: £88,166 – £96,985 GBP
  • Brussels, Belgium: €109,574 – €120,534 EUR
  • Amsterdam, Netherlands: €103,764 – €120,333 EUR


In Belgium, the required 13th-month pay and double holiday pay are paid on top of this base salary range. In the Netherlands, the statutory 8% holiday allowance is paid on top of this base salary range.


Benefits


PAI offers a generous paid leave and benefits package. Time off, health, and retirement benefits are tailored to each country, with the aim of being comparable to our US package. Our benefits currently include:

  • Generous paid vacation, local public holidays, three personal reflection days, and sick and family leave in line with or above local requirements
  • Health and retirement benefits tailored to each country
  • Monthly cell phone reimbursement
  • Annual funds to support professional development
  • Monthly allowance for co-working space access
  • Regular team lunches and focused work days
  • Opportunities to attend AI-related conferences and collaborate with our partners across industry, academia, and civil society


Please refer to our careers page for an updated list of benefits.


Location and Work Authorization

  • PAI is a remote-first organization with a global membership base and scope. This role is eligible for remote work in London (UK), Brussels (Belgium), or Amsterdam (Netherlands).
  • Candidates must be authorized to work in the country where they will be based. We are unable to sponsor visas at this time.


Partnership on AI (PAI) is committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and supported.


We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences and make employment decisions based on qualifications, skills, experience, and organizational needs, without discrimination. Our commitment to equal opportunity extends to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, professional development, advancement, compensation, and benefits.


We are committed to providing an accessible and inclusive recruitment process. Candidates who require reasonable adjustments or accommodations during the hiring process are encouraged to let us know.


HOW TO APPLY


Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled. To apply, please submit a cover letter and resume.

Our hiring process typically includes an initial HR screen, one or more interviews with the hiring team, and a final conversation with senior leadership. We aim to keep candidates informed at each stage and will communicate expected timelines at the outset.

Get to Know Darwoft

At Darwoft, we build custom software solutions and partner with international companies to create high-impact digital products.

We are a Latin American technology company with a people-first culture, strong professional standards, and a long-term partnership mindset. We work with distributed teams, complex technical challenges, and clients whose technology has a direct impact on their businesses and users.

About the Project

We are partnering with an innovative cybersecurity company building a next-generation Identity Security and Identity Observability platform .

The product helps enterprise security teams understand how human users, service accounts, workloads, applications, and AI-driven identities access systems across cloud, SaaS, network, endpoint, and on-premise environments .

At the core of the platform is a highly data-intensive architecture that collects and analyzes large volumes of events, logs, network telemetry, identity activity, and security signals . This information is processed to identify unusual access patterns, security risks, identity blind spots, infrastructure misconfigurations, and potential threats.

The platform integrates with complex enterprise ecosystems including identity providers, cloud platforms, SASE solutions, SIEMs, endpoint security tools, network infrastructure, and security services.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer focused on Data Ingestion, Integrations, and Collectors to become a key technical bridge between enterprise customers and the engineering organization.

This is not a traditional backend or internal data engineering position.

You'll work directly with customers to understand their infrastructure, data sources, security architecture, network topology, APIs, and workflows, then design and implement scalable mechanisms to ingest that information into the platform.

You'll combine data engineering, software engineering, solution architecture, cloud infrastructure, and technical consulting .

A major part of your mission will be building and evolving connectors and ingestion pipelines capable of integrating data from complex enterprise environments while maintaining reliability, scalability, security, and fast time-to-production.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design, develop, and maintain production-grade data collectors, connectors, and ingestion services .

  • Develop backend services primarily using Python and/or Go .
  • Work with SQL and NoSQL databases to store, transform, query, and analyze high-volume data.
  • Build and operate containerized services using Docker and Kubernetes .
  • Deploy and integrate solutions across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments .
  • Troubleshoot complex customer deployment and integration issues across application, infrastructure, networking, API, and data layers.
  • Optimize ingestion performance, reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.

  • Act as a trusted technical advisor around customer data architecture, collection strategies, security integrations, and implementation best practices.

  • Production experience with at least one major cloud platform:
    • AWS

  • Strong understanding of Git-based development workflows and CI/CD practices .
  • Experience designing reliable, scalable, and production-ready distributed systems.

  • Experience working directly with customers, stakeholders, or technical partners.
  • Ability to translate complex customer requirements into pragmatic technical solutions.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to operate effectively in customer-facing technical conversations.
  • High degree of autonomy and ownership when solving ambiguous technical problems.

Highly Relevant Experience

Experience with any of the following will be especially valuable:

  • Identity and Access Management ( IAM )
  • Identity Providers ( IdPs )
  • Identity Security
  • Cybersecurity platforms
  • SIEM systems
  • Security telemetry

Clients rate them 4.9 out of 5 in verified reviews, and the startups they build for have raised more than $25M in venture funding.

Your Role

You’ll join the team building workflow software for one of the studio's clients: a live product that needs new workflow features while the existing ones keep running. The client's own engineers commit to the same repo, so every new table, permission and workflow goes in next to code someone else is changing. The weight is on the server side, from the SQL database on Azure up through the API, and you also build the React and TypeScript screens that sit on top.

AI coding tools draft most of the specs, tests and migrations. You direct them, read every diff line by line, and answer for what merges. If you'd rather write most of the code by hand, this probably isn't the right seat.

You report to the studio's leadership and work day to day with the lead developer and the product manager, who sets the acceptance criteria for each sprint. Success means delivering four to five features per two-week sprint, each verified before merge, and owning one area end to end (such as the task engine or the legacy migration) without breaking a live feature.

  • Clear written and spoken English
  • Experience delivering in fixed-scope sprints with branches, code review and feature flags

Bonus Points:

  • Work in a regulated setting such as finance, health or insurance
  • A migration from a legacy system, with reconciliation and duplicate review
  • Time as an outside vendor committing to a client's repo
  • Project rules, custom prompts or agent setups for AI coding tools that your team adopted
  • Spanish, since the platform is bilingual

What's Offered:

  • Fully remote contractor role from LATAM, full time at about 40 hours a week
  • Core hours in US time zones, so your day overlaps with the lead developer and the product manager
  • An area of the product to own end to end, with your schema designs reviewed by the lead developer and the client's engineers
  • A team where AI-first delivery is already the daily routine, with tests, CI and feature flags as part of the normal process

At Bigham’s Smokehouse, we believe leadership is about more than being in charge. It is about serving people well, setting the standard, encouraging the team, and helping create a family atmosphere for both our guests and our employees.

Our family has been serving West Texas since 1978, and we are looking for a Part-Time Team Leader who wants to be part of something meaningful. This is a great opportunity for someone who is responsible, mature, dependable, and interested in growing as a leader.

A great Part-Time Team Leader at Bigham’s understands that we are in the people business, not just the food business. Food quality matters. Speed matters. Cleanliness matters. But the way we treat our team and serve our guests matters just as much.

This role is fast-paced, hands-on, and team-focused. You will help lead the shift, support Team Members, protect food quality, and make sure guests are served with care and consistency. From building plates to cleaning floors, you understand that every task matters when it is done with excellence.

At Bigham’s, we value Excellence, Consistency, Loyalty, and Service. These values guide how we work, how we lead, how we treat one another, and how we serve our community.

What This Role Looks Like

As a Part-Time Team Leader, you will help set the tone for the shift. You will lead by example, communicate clearly, and help the team stay organized and focused.

You are someone who can hold people accountable while still showing respect, kindness, and patience. You understand that leadership means serving the team, not just telling people what to do.

You enjoy helping others succeed under pressure. You notice what needs to be done, jump in where help is needed, and help Team Members understand why their work matters.

You also understand the value of systems. Checklists, cleaning standards, food quality standards, and accountability tools help the team succeed and keep the restaurant running with consistency.

Responsibilities

As a Part-Time Team Leader, you will be expected to:

  • Lead the team with a service-first, team-first mindset
  • Set the tone for the shift through attitude, work ethic, and communication
  • Help Team Members feel supported, prepared, and empowered
  • Hold the team accountable with respect, kindness, and clarity
  • Make sure food quality, presentation, and consistency meet Bigham’s standards
  • Keep the shift organized and help the team stay focused during busy times
  • Communicate clearly with Team Members, managers, and guests
  • Lead by example in every task, including serving food, cleaning, stocking, and helping where needed
  • Use checklists, cleaning standards, and other systems to help the restaurant run well
  • Maintain a clean, safe, and welcoming environment
  • Help train and encourage Team Members
  • Serve guests with genuine hospitality and care
  • Represent Bigham’s values of Excellence, Consistency, Loyalty, and Service
What We’re Looking For

A strong candidate is someone who is:

  • Mature, dependable, and responsible
  • Team-oriented and willing to serve others
  • Able to lead by example
  • Comfortable giving direction and holding others accountable
  • Kind, respectful, and steady under pressure
  • Teachable and open to feedback
  • Organized and able to manage multiple tasks
  • Able to work in a fast-paced restaurant environment
  • Able to communicate clearly with teammates, managers, and guests
  • Able to stand for several hours at a time
  • Able to lift, carry, or pull heavy objects when needed
  • Willing to complete or maintain a Food Handler’s Certification or Manager Food Safety Certification if required
Leadership experience is helpful, but strong character, ownership, humility, and a desire to grow as a leader matter just as much.

Schedule

This is a part-time leadership position. Hours may vary based on restaurant needs and availability. Evening and weekend availability is a plus.

This role may be a good fit for college students, college-aged candidates, young professionals, or anyone looking for meaningful part-time leadership experience in a values-driven, team-focused environment.

Why Work at Bigham’s?

At Bigham’s, leadership means helping people become better while serving guests with excellence. We want leaders who care about people, care about standards, and care about doing things the right way.

You will grow in responsibility, communication, teamwork, accountability, and servant-hearted leadership. You will be part of a workplace built around family, service, integrity, and strong values.

If you are looking for a part-time leadership role where you can work hard, serve others, grow people, and be part of a team that feels like family, we would love for you to apply.

Get to Know Darwoft

At Darwoft, we build custom software solutions and partner with international companies to create high-impact digital products.

We are a Latin American technology company with a people-first culture, strong professional standards, and a long-term partnership mindset. We work with distributed teams, complex technical challenges, and clients whose technology has a direct impact on their businesses and users.

About the Project

We are partnering with an innovative cybersecurity company building a next-generation Identity Security and Identity Observability platform .

The product helps enterprise security teams understand how human users, service accounts, workloads, applications, and AI-driven identities access systems across cloud, SaaS, network, endpoint, and on-premise environments .

At the core of the platform is a highly data-intensive architecture that collects and analyzes large volumes of events, logs, network telemetry, identity activity, and security signals . This information is processed to identify unusual access patterns, security risks, identity blind spots, infrastructure misconfigurations, and potential threats.

The platform integrates with complex enterprise ecosystems including identity providers, cloud platforms, SASE solutions, SIEMs, endpoint security tools, network infrastructure, and security services.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer focused on Data Ingestion, Integrations, and Collectors to become a key technical bridge between enterprise customers and the engineering organization.

This is not a traditional backend or internal data engineering position.

You’ll work directly with customers to understand their infrastructure, data sources, security architecture, network topology, APIs, and workflows, then design and implement scalable mechanisms to ingest that information into the platform.

You’ll combine data engineering, software engineering, solution architecture, cloud infrastructure, and technical consulting .

A major part of your mission will be building and evolving connectors and ingestion pipelines capable of integrating data from complex enterprise environments while maintaining reliability, scalability, security, and fast time‑to‑production.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Design, develop, and maintain production‑grade data collectors, connectors, and ingestion services .
  • Integrate enterprise data sources including identity providers, cloud platforms, SASE solutions, network infrastructure, endpoints, applications, security platforms, and SIEM systems .
  • Work directly with enterprise customers to understand their environments, data flows, APIs, security requirements, and integration constraints.
  • Participate in technical onboarding processes, from initial discovery and architecture design through production deployment.
  • Design scalable ingestion architectures for processing security events, logs, identity activity, network telemetry, and other high‑volume data sources .
  • Build integrations using REST APIs, cloud‑native services, event‑driven architectures, and modern software engineering practices .
  • Develop backend services primarily using Python and/or Go .
  • Work with SQL and NoSQL databases to store, transform, query, and analyze high‑volume data.
  • Build and operate containerized services using Docker and Kubernetes .
  • Deploy and integrate solutions across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments .
  • Troubleshoot complex customer deployment and integration issues across application, infrastructure, networking, API, and data layers.
  • Optimize ingestion performance, reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with Solution Architects, Sales Engineering, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering teams.
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor around customer data architecture, collection strategies, security integrations, and implementation best practices.
  • Identify recurring customer requirements and transform them into reusable connectors, platform capabilities, or improvements to the core product.
  • Contribute technical insights from real‑world implementations to the product roadmap.
  • Support production adoption and continuously improve time‑to‑value for enterprise customers.
  • Participate in occasional customer‑facing technical sessions and, when necessary, onsite engagements.

What You Bring

  • 10+ years of professional Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, or related experience.
  • Strong software development experience with:
    • Python
    • Go
  • Strong experience designing and consuming REST APIs .
  • Hands‑on experience building data ingestion pipelines, connector frameworks, integration platforms, or similar systems .
  • Experience integrating complex enterprise systems and third‑party platforms.
  • Solid understanding of both SQL and NoSQL databases .
  • Production experience with at least one major cloud platform:
    • AWS
    • Azure
    • GCP
  • Experience working with Docker and Kubernetes .
  • Strong understanding of Git‑based development workflows and CI/CD practices .
  • Experience designing reliable, scalable, and production‑ready distributed systems.
  • Strong debugging skills across APIs, infrastructure, networking, application services, and data pipelines.
  • Experience working directly with customers, stakeholders, or technical partners.
  • Ability to translate complex customer requirements into pragmatic technical solutions.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to operate effectively in customer‑facing technical conversations.
  • High degree of autonomy and ownership when solving ambiguous technical problems.

Highly Relevant Experience

Experience with any of the following will be especially valuable:

  • IAM
  • IdPs
  • Identity Security
  • Cybersecurity platforms
  • SIEM systems
  • Security telemetry
  • Network security
  • Endpoint security
  • SASE / Zero Trust environments
  • Cloud security
  • Large‑scale event processing
  • Streaming architectures

Integration Experience

Previous experience integrating APIs or data from platforms such as the following is highly valuable:

  • AWS
  • Microsoft Azure
  • Google Cloud
  • Microsoft Entra ID / Active Directory
  • Okta
  • Google Workspace
  • Duo
  • CrowdStrike
  • Zscaler
  • Palo Alto
  • Microsoft Defender
  • SIEM and security analytics platforms

Direct experience with every platform is not required. What matters is a strong track record of learning complex APIs and transforming heterogeneous enterprise data sources into reliable integrations.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with large‑scale data processing or streaming platforms.
  • Experience designing reusable connector SDKs or integration frameworks .
  • Understanding of identity-related security concepts such as authentication, authorization, credentials, service accounts, privileged access, and non-human identities.
  • Experience with security events, audit logs, network telemetry, or cloud activity data.
  • Familiarity with event-driven and distributed system architectures.

  • Exposure to LLMs, AI agents, or AI-powered security applications .
  • Solution Architecture or Forward Deployed Engineering experience.
  • Previous experience in cybersecurity startups or high-growth SaaS environments.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role will be measured by your ability to:

  • Deliver successful enterprise integrations and deployments.
  • Reduce customer time‑to‑production.
  • Build reliable and scalable ingestion solutions.
  • Improve customer adoption and technical satisfaction.

  • Own data ingestion & pipeline architecture — connect and maintain API pipelines from paid media platforms (Meta, Google Ads, LinkedIn, TikTok, programmatic) into Adverity, build custom Python connectors for anything not natively supported, and architect scalable pipelines from source system through to dashboard
  • Own CRM integration — build and maintain reliable CRM data connections (Slate, Salesforce, HubSpot) so lead and enrollment data flows cleanly into the warehouse
  • Own the data warehouse — route, optimize, and store raw and processed data in Google BigQuery; design efficient schemas for complex, multi-source marketing data (granularity, normalization, slowly changing dimensions); manage partitioning, clustering, and storage strategy to control query cost and performance

  • Own CI/CD & data segregation — maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, automated testing) for robust, version-controlled releases, and enforce strict data segregation across multi-client environments
  • Enable the reporting layer — create clean, performant data views built specifically for fast Looker Studio dashboards and automated Google Sheets reports, and partner with the Data and Analytics Manager and client teams to translate reporting requirements into warehouse models
  • Drive data quality — monitor pipeline health, resolve API breaks, minimize latency, implement validation frameworks and automated testing, troubleshoot discrepancies to root cause across source/warehouse/BI layers, and proactively flag data quality risks to leadership

You Bring

  • 5+ years of hands‑on data engineering experience, ideally in a marketing or agency environment
  • Strong experience configuring datastreams, transformations, and destinations in Adverity or a comparable ETL platform (Fivetran, Supermetrics, Funnel)
  • Intermediate to advanced SQL, with proven BigQuery experience in transformation, partitioning, and modeling

  • Python proficiency for custom API connections and pipeline automation
  • Experience with CRM data flows and integrations (Slate, Salesforce, and/or HubSpot)

  • Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows, and proven ability to manage multi‑client data environments with strict data segregation
  • An analytical, solution‑driven mindset with a growth orientation, and strong communication skills that turn complex data workflows into clear narratives for non‑technical audiences — education marketing experience (traditional or online) is especially valued

Bonus Points

  • Experience integrating AI‑driven insights or machine learning models into marketing data pipelines to sharpen predictive analytics and data utility
  • Familiarity using AI or LLM tools to optimize performance forecasting, automated audience segmentation, or marketing workflows
  • Experience connecting, managing, and maintaining APIs for generative AI platforms within a marketing data architecture
  • Experience using AI/ML‑driven anomaly detection to monitor pipelines and proactively flag data quality issues

What’s Offered

  • Remote role with the flexibility that comes with a distributed, async‑friendly team

  • A culture built around finding a better way, playing as a team of A‑players, and treating results as the engine rather than the goal
  • Direct impact: the pipelines and models you build directly shape how partners see (and trust) their own performance data

Team Leader

At Bigham’s Smokehouse, we believe leadership is about more than being in charge. It is about serving people well, setting the standard, building up the team, and helping others succeed.

Our family has been serving West Texas since 1978, and we are looking for Team Leaders who want to be part of something meaningful. This is a great opportunity for someone with strong responsibility, maturity, and leadership potential who wants to grow in communication, accountability, teamwork, and service.

A great Team Leader at Bigham’s understands that we are in the people business, not just the food business. Food quality matters. Speed matters. Cleanliness matters. But the way we lead people, serve guests, and care for the team matters just as much.

We are looking for someone who enjoys leading a team through a successful shift. From serving food to cleaning floors, a Team Leader sees every task as an opportunity to set the tone, encourage the team, and make sure the job is done with excellence.

At Bigham’s, we value Excellence, Consistency, Loyalty, and Service. These values guide how we work, how we lead, how we treat one another, and how we serve our guests.

What This Role Looks Like

As a Team Leader, you will help lead the restaurant during your shift. You will support the team, keep the shift organized, make sure food is served with quality and consistency, and help create a great experience for every guest.

You are someone who can hold people accountable while still showing kindness, respect, and patience. You understand that strong leadership means both setting clear expectations and helping people grow into what they are capable of becoming.

You enjoy seeing people succeed under pressure. You communicate clearly, lead by example, and help your team understand not just what needs to be done, but why it matters.

You also understand the value of systems. Checklists, food orders, inventory, cleaning standards, and accountability tools are not a burden to you. You see them as structure that helps the team succeed and keeps the restaurant running with consistency.

Responsibilities

As a Team Leader, you will be expected to:

  • Lead the team with a service-first, team-first mindset
  • Set the tone for the shift through attitude, work ethic, and communication
  • Help Team Members feel supported, prepared, and empowered
  • Hold the team accountable with respect, kindness, and clarity
  • Make sure food quality, presentation, and consistency meet Bigham’s standards
  • Keep the shift organized and help the team stay focused under pressure
  • Communicate clearly with Team Members and management
  • Lead by example in every task, including serving food, cleaning, stocking, and helping where needed
  • Use checklists, systems, food orders, inventory, and other tools to keep the restaurant running well
  • Help maintain a clean, safe, and welcoming environment
  • Support training and development of Team Members
  • Make sure guests are served with genuine hospitality and care
  • Represent Bigham’s values of Excellence, Consistency, Loyalty, and Service
What We’re Looking For

A strong candidate is someone who is:

  • Mature, dependable, and responsible
  • A clear communicator
  • Team-oriented and willing to serve others
  • Able to lead by example
  • Comfortable holding others accountable
  • Kind, respectful, and steady under pressure
  • Teachable and open to feedback
  • Organized and able to manage multiple priorities
  • Able to work in a fast-paced restaurant environment
  • Able to stand for up to 8 hours at a time
  • Able to lift, carry, or pull heavy objects when needed
  • Willing to complete or maintain a Manager Food Safety Certification
Leadership experience is preferred, but we are also interested in people with strong character, high ownership, and the desire to grow as a leader.

Schedule

This is a full-time leadership position. Hours may vary based on restaurant needs and availability. Daytime, evening, and weekend availability is preferred.

This role may be a good fit for college-aged candidates, recent graduates, young professionals, or anyone looking for a meaningful leadership opportunity in a values-driven, team-focused environment.

Why Work at Bigham’s?

At Bigham’s, leadership means helping people become better. We want leaders who care about their team, care about guests, and care about doing things the right way.

You will grow in responsibility, communication, organization, accountability, and servant-hearted leadership. You will be part of a workplace built around family, service, integrity, and strong values.

If you are looking for a leadership role where you can work hard, serve others, grow people, and be part of a team that feels like family, we would love for you to apply.

Get to Know Darwoft

At Darwoft, we build custom software solutions and partner with international companies to create high-impact digital products.

We are a Latin American technology company with a people-first culture, strong professional standards, and a long-term partnership mindset. We work with distributed teams, complex technical challenges, and clients whose technology has a direct impact on their businesses and users.

About the Project

We are partnering with an innovative cybersecurity company building a next-generation Identity Security and Identity Observability platform .

The product helps enterprise security teams understand how human users, service accounts, workloads, applications, and AI-driven identities access systems across cloud, SaaS, network, endpoint, and on-premise environments .

At the core of the platform is a highly data-intensive architecture that collects and analyzes large volumes of events, logs, network telemetry, identity activity, and security signals . This information is processed to identify unusual access patterns, security risks, identity blind spots, infrastructure misconfigurations, and potential threats.

The platform integrates with complex enterprise ecosystems including identity providers, cloud platforms, SASE solutions, SIEMs, endpoint security tools, network infrastructure, and security services.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer focused on Data Ingestion, Integrations, and Collectors to become a key technical bridge between enterprise customers and the engineering organization.

This is not a traditional backend or internal data engineering position.

You'll work directly with customers to understand their infrastructure, data sources, security architecture, network topology, APIs, and workflows, then design and implement scalable mechanisms to ingest that information into the platform.

You'll combine data engineering, software engineering, solution architecture, cloud infrastructure, and technical consulting .

A major part of your mission will be building and evolving connectors and ingestion pipelines capable of integrating data from complex enterprise environments while maintaining reliability, scalability, security, and fast time-to-production.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design, develop, and maintain production-grade data collectors, connectors, and ingestion services .
  • Integrate enterprise data sources including identity providers, cloud platforms, SASE solutions, network infrastructure, endpoints, applications, security platforms, and SIEM systems .

  • Develop backend services primarily using Python and/or Go .
  • Work with SQL and NoSQL databases to store, transform, query, and analyze high-volume data.
  • Build and operate containerized services using Docker and Kubernetes .
  • Deploy and integrate solutions across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments .
  • Troubleshoot complex customer deployment and integration issues across application, infrastructure, networking, API, and data layers.
  • Optimize ingestion performance, reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with Solution Architects, Sales Engineering, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering teams.
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor around customer data architecture, collection strategies, security integrations, and implementation best practices.
  • Identify recurring customer requirements and transform them into reusable connectors, platform capabilities, or improvements to the core product.
  • Contribute technical insights from real-world implementations to the product roadmap.
  • Support production adoption and continuously improve time-to-value for enterprise customers.
  • Participate in occasional customer-facing technical sessions and, when necessary, onsite engagements.

    • AWS

We began in Milan in 2011 with the purpose to help more people improve their financial well-being by making personal investing simple and accessible through technology. Fast forward to today, and we are recognised as one of the most innovative fintechs, headquartered in the heart of London.

With a team of 220+ people across 4 offices in Italy and the UK, we are proudly backed and funded by major partners including Poste Italiane, Cabot Square Capital, United Ventures, and Allianz.

Our vision

Our vision is to combine passion, expertise, and technology to provide best-in-class investment solutions and advice that protects and grows client wealth over time.

Our Core Values:

We’ve built our business on three Principles:

  • Relationships are our first asset: We’re one team, built on trust, honesty, and transparency. We value our relationships above all else.
  • Trust drives success: We give each other the space to grow. We empower our employees to succeed, so they can make a real impact.
  • Our customers dream big, just like us: We see the bigger picture and we make sure our customers see it, too. We’re always focused on the best outcomes for our clients and for each other, no matter what the goal, or how big the dream

What this means in practice:

At Moneyfarm, our success comes from the impact each of us makes. We move with purpose, urgency, and ambition, focused on delivering outcomes that matter for our clients and our business. Everyone is empowered to take ownership, challenge the status quo, and turn bold ideas into results. As we evolve, we embrace AI as a catalyst for sharper thinking, smarter decisions, and even greater impact.

Our diversity makes this possible. Different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences fuel our creativity and drive better decisions — it’s our competitive edge. We value people for who they are and their unique strengths: that's why we offer flexible ways of working to support them in doing their best work.

About the role
As a Pension Consultant, you’ll be the first voice many of our clients hear. You’ll help them understand their pensions, talk through their investment and retirement options, and make sure they feel confident about their next steps.

Most of your conversations will be by phone, with some messaging. As you settle in, you’ll take on your own client book and work towards a mix of quantitative and qualitative targets, including positive net inflows.
The role combines commercial and advisory work, but good client outcomes always come first. It’s also a strong first step towards a career as a pension or investment adviser. We’ll give you full training, and you can choose to study for professional exams.

What you’ll do

  • Act as the first point of contact for clients and represent the firm on every call, making sure each client has a great experience.
  • Give clear, practical guidance that helps clients work towards their financial goals.
  • Handle a high volume of client calls and messages each day, covering pension questions, investments, retirement options, withdrawals and annual suitability reviews.
  • Keep an eye on a large client base, spotting both opportunities and potential concerns early.
  • Respond to every client interaction promptly and accurately.
  • Keep thorough records in Salesforce and follow up on any open issues until they’re resolved.
  • Work with colleagues across the business to resolve more complex queries.

Requirements

Essential

  • Experience in fintech, wealth management or pensions.
  • Strong organisation and time management, and the ability to juggle several tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent spoken and written communication, with an empathetic, client-focused approach.
  • A proactive, solution-focused attitude, with strong attention to detail.
  • Reliability and discretion when handling sensitive information.



Desirable

  • A degree in economics, finance or a related subject.
  • Previous client-facing experience.
  • Progress towards CII, CISI, IMC or CFA qualifications.

Benefits

  • Health insurance and a wellness plan
  • Company pension plan
  • Fee-free investing on the Moneyfarm platform
  • Full training, with support to study for professional qualifications
  • Regular office social events
  • A happy, friendly team culture

  • Drive data quality monitor pipeline health, resolve API breaks, minimize latency, implement validation frameworks and automated testing, troubleshoot discrepancies to root cause across source/warehouse/BI layers, and proactively flag data quality risks to leadership

You Bring:

  • Strong experience configuring datastreams, transformations, and destinations in Adverity or a comparable ETL platform (Fivetran, Supermetrics, Funnel)

  • Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows, and proven ability to manage multi-client data environments with strict data segregation

  • An analytical, solution-driven mindset with a growth orientation, and strong communication skills that turn complex data workflows into clear narratives for non-technical audiences — education marketing experience (traditional or online) is especially valued

Bonus Points:

  • Familiarity using AI or LLM tools to optimize performance forecasting, automated audience segmentation, or marketing workflows

  • Experience connecting, managing, and maintaining APIs for generative AI platforms within a marketing data architecture

  • Experience using AI/ML-driven anomaly detection to monitor pipelines and proactively flag data quality issues

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to support and execute a critical observability migration. In this role, you will lead the transition of our application and infrastructure telemetry from New Relic to a modern, OpenTelemetry (OTel) Collector-based architecture. You will be responsible for re-instrumenting applications, updating infrastructure manifests, validating telemetry outputs, and ensuring seamless monitoring coverage across our high-scale ecosystem without compromising operational visibility.

Key Responsibilities

  • Migrate existing application instrumentation, tracing, and telemetry configurations from New Relic to OpenTelemetry.
  • Update YAML configuration files, environment variables, and deployment manifests according to established architecture standards.
  • Execute unit tests and validation suites to verify that telemetry is accurately generated, transformed, and exported to target backends.
  • Perform telemetry gap analysis, comparing existing New Relic data against OTel outputs to identify missing traces, metrics, logs, or resource attributes.
  • Assist in updating dashboards, monitoring documentation, and troubleshooting guides to reflect the OTel architecture.
  • Investigate telemetry collection and export errors, identifying root causes and collaborating with core platform engineers on complex edge cases.
  • Maintain clear tracking and reporting of implementation progress, edge cases, and potential migration risks.

Requirements

Must-Have:

  • Proven experience in software engineering with proficiency in at least one modern language (Java, Python, Go, or JavaScript/TypeScript).
  • Hands-on experience with OpenTelemetry (OTel) concepts, including distributed tracing, metrics, logs, and OTel Collector configurations.
  • Deep experience with cloud observability paradigms and transitioning off legacy platforms like New Relic.
  • Solid understanding of APIs, environment-based configurations, and reading/modifying complex YAML/JSON manifests.
  • Strong background in software testing, debugging log analysis, and validating high-cardinality telemetry data.
  • Familiarity with modern software delivery workflows (Git, PRs, CI/CD pipelines).

Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience operating or configuring OTel Collectors in Kubernetes or containerized environments.
  • Knowledge of FinOps and cost-optimization strategies related to telemetry ingestion rates.

Key Deliverables & Success Criteria

  • Execution: Successfully updated application instrumentation, validated OTel Collector configs, and verified end-to-end telemetry delivery to designated backends.
  • Documentation: Updated technical documentation, migration checklists, and runbooks.
  • Quality & Continuity: Zero removal of critical monitoring coverage during the migration window, with all pull requests passing automated tests and code reviews.

What We Offer (Contractor)

  • Contractor agreement with payment in USD.
  • 100% remote work in an international setting.
  • Access to Argentine public holidays.
  • Direct involvement in modernizing core platform observability for a high-growth fintech ecosystem.
  • Professional development, learning platforms, and referral programs.

title: Ai Software Engineer
description:
Our client is a remote product studio that builds MVPs and custom software for startups and companies past the idea stage. Clients hire them for a fixed-scope MVP or for a product team billed by the two-week sprint, and the whole team uses AI coding tools every day.

They've been at it since 2020 and were profitable in 2025, with a 30% net margin. After building their own AI systems, they tripled monthly revenue with the same team size. Clients rate them 4.9 out of 5 in verified reviews, and the startups they build for have raised more than $25M in venture funding.

Your Role

You'll join the team building workflow software for one of the studio's clients: a live product that needs new workflow features while the existing ones keep running. The client's own engineers commit to the same repo, so every new table, permission and workflow goes in next to code someone else is changing. The weight is on the server side, from the SQL database on Azure up through the API, and you also build the React and TypeScript screens that sit on top.

AI coding tools draft most of the specs, tests and migrations. You direct them, read every diff line by line, and answer for what merges. If you'd rather write most of the code by hand, this probably isn't the right seat.

You report to the studio's leadership and work day to day with the lead developer and the product manager, who sets the acceptance criteria for each sprint. Success means delivering four to five features per two-week sprint, each verified before merge, and owning one area end to end (such as the task engine or the legacy migration) without breaking a live feature.

You'll:

  • Extend the production SQL database on Azure with new tables, permissions and versioned records
  • Write the server-side workflow rules: state machines, approval gates and independent review steps
  • Enforce role-based access by company and assignment at both the database and the API
  • Build the audit log, stale-write protection and idempotent endpoints so a retry never duplicates data
  • Build the React and TypeScript work queues, bulk assignment tools and dashboards
  • Integrate email, SMS and file storage providers, and design the sync APIs the mobile application calls
  • Write migrations from legacy sources, with reconciliation reports and a duplicate review step
  • Break each sprint's scope into small PRs and verify every acceptance criterion before merge

You Bring:

  • 4+ years building full-stack web applications and releasing them to production
  • Experience working in a codebase you didn't write, learning its conventions before changing it
  • Hands-on work on workflow software where different user roles see different data, with approvals, task queues or state machines and an audit log or versioned history
  • React, TypeScript and SQL on Azure, including schema design and migrations
  • Daily use of Cursor, Claude Code or a similar AI coding tool on production work, with tests and CI behind it
  • Clear written and spoken English: PRs that say what changed, why, and how it was tested, and tradeoffs explained to another team's engineers
  • Experience delivering in fixed-scope sprints with branches, code review and feature flags

Bonus Points:

  • Work in a regulated setting such as finance, health or insurance
  • A migration from a legacy system, with reconciliation and duplicate review
  • Time as an outside vendor committing to a client's repo
  • Project rules, custom prompts or agent setups for AI coding tools that your team adopted
  • Spanish, since the platform is bilingual

What's Offered:

  • Fully remote contractor role from LATAM, full time at about 40 hours a week
  • Core hours in US time zones, so your day overlaps with the lead developer and the product manager
  • An area of the product to own end to end, with your schema designs reviewed by the lead developer and the client's engineers
  • A team where AI-first delivery is already the daily routine, with tests, CI and feature flags as part of the normal process
  • A start in early November

Interview Process:

  1. Intro Call: 30 minutes with atomic HR on your background and goals
  2. Leadership Screening: A short call, possibly with an async part first
  3. Product and Developer Conversation: How you take features from acceptance criteria to merge
  4. Take-Home Test: One feature like the real scope, built and checked

description:
Our client is a remote product studio that builds MVPs and custom software for startups and companies past the idea stage. Clients hire them for a fixed-scope MVP or for a product team billed by the two-week sprint, and the whole team uses AI coding tools every day.

They've been at it since 2020 and were profitable in 2025, with a 30% net margin. After building their own AI systems, they tripled monthly revenue with the same team size. Clients rate them 4.9 out of 5 in verified reviews, and the startups they build for have raised more than $25M in venture funding.

Your Role

You’ll join the team building workflow software for one of the studio’s clients: a live product that needs new workflow features while the existing ones keep running. The client’s own engineers commit to the same repo, so every new table, permission and workflow goes in next to code someone else is changing. The weight is on the server side, from the SQL database on Azure up through the API, and you also build the React and TypeScript screens that sit on top.

AI coding tools draft most of the specs, tests and migrations. You direct them, read every diff line by line, and answer for what merges. If you’d rather write most of the code by hand, this probably isn’t the right seat.

You report to the studio’s leadership and work day to day with the lead developer and the product manager, who sets the acceptance criteria for each sprint. Success means delivering four to five features per two-week sprint, each verified before merge, and owning one area end to end (such as the task engine or the legacy migration) without breaking a live feature.

You’ll:

  • Extend the production SQL database on Azure with new tables, permissions and versioned records
  • Write the server-side workflow rules: state machines, approval gates and independent review steps
  • Enforce role-based access by company and assignment at both the database and the API
  • Build the audit log, stale-write protection and idempotent endpoints so a retry never duplicates data
  • Build the React and TypeScript work queues, bulk assignment tools and dashboards

The product helps enterprise security teams understand how human users, service accounts, workloads, applications, and AI-driven identities access systems across cloud, SaaS, network, endpoint, and on-premise environments .

Your Role

You’ll join the team building workflow software for one of the studio's clients: a live product that needs new workflow features while the existing ones keep running. The client's own engineers commit to the same repo, so every new table, permission and workflow goes in next to code someone else is changing. The weight is on the server side, from the SQL database on Azure up through the API, and you also build the React and TypeScript screens that sit on top.

AI coding tools draft most of the specs, tests and migrations. You direct them, read every diff line by line, and answer for what merges. If you'd rather write most of the code by hand, this probably isn't the right seat.

You report to the studio's leadership and work day to day with the lead developer and the product manager, who sets the acceptance criteria for each sprint.   • React, TypeScript and SQL on Azure, including schema design and migrations
  • Daily use of Cursor, Claude Code or a similar AI coding tool on production work, with tests and CI behind it
  • Clear written and spoken English
  • Experience delivering in fixed-scope sprints with branches, code review and feature flags

  • Time as an outside vendor committing to a client's repo
  • Project rules, custom prompts or agent setups for AI coding tools that your team adopted
  • Spanish, since the platform is bilingual

  • Core hours in US time zones, so your day overlaps with the lead developer and the product manager
  • An area of the product to own end to end, with your schema designs reviewed by the lead developer and the client's engineers
  • A team where AI-first delivery is already the daily routine, with tests, CI and feature flags as part of the normal process
  • A start in early November

  • 2 Leadership Screening: A short call, possibly with an async part first
  • 3 Product and Developer Conversation: How you take features from acceptance criteria to merge
  • 4 Take-Home Test: One feature like the real scope, built and checked

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people‑first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Mid-level Data Engineer to build and maintain dbt pipelines and Snowflake data marts behind customer‑facing reporting, spend analytics, and AI features.

The mandatory requirements are solid dbt experience (modeling, tests, macros, and incremental models), ingestion and orchestration tools such as Airbyte or Prefect, 3+ years in data or analytics engineering on production pipelines, strong SQL and Python, dimensional modeling, Snowflake or a similar cloud warehouse, and an upper‑intermediate English level.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Build and maintain the dbt pipelines, data marts, and warehouse models that serve in‑app reporting, spend analytics, AI features, and internal analytics, treating them as production systems.
  • Translate complicated procurement business logic into maintainable, well‑tested pipeline code, and notice when a model is valid‑looking but wrong.
  • Build models within our data mart architecture, following the chapter's conventions for grain, conformed dimensions, and incremental patterns, and propose improvements when you find them.
  • Contribute to and help buildout the semantic layer that our internal MCP servers and AI agents query, so that metrics and dimensions are defined once and answered consistently.
  • Maintain the boundary between PII and agent/reporting‑safe data.
  • Build and maintain the FastAPI services that expose reporting marts to customers.
  • Build and maintain ingestion pipelines (Airbyte, OneSchema, S3) into the warehouse, and support our Forward Deployed Engineering function in bringing customer data into our systems.
  • Implement data quality checks: freshness, schema and reconciliation tests, and alerting, so problems surface before customers find them.
  • Implement metric definitions faithfully, and flag conflicting or ambiguous definitions to the chapter rather than guessing.
  • Keep documentation and lineage current so that humans and AI agents can both find and trust what's in the warehouse.
  • Tune Snowflake performance and cost within the models you build.
  • Use agentic coding tools in your daily work, within the guardrails (tests, conventions, review patterns) the team maintains, and understand why those guardrails exist.
  • Share what you learn through code review and team discussion.
  • Communicate clearly with engineering, product, and customer‑facing teams about what the data means and what it can and can't do.

MUST HAVES

  • 3+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a closely related role, including hands‑on work on production data pipelines that other systems or customers depended on.
  • Solid dbt experience: modeling, tests, macros, and incremental models.
  • Strong SQL and working Python.
  • Data modeling fundamentals: dimensional modeling, data marts, grain and conformance.
  • Experience with a modern cloud warehouse (Snowflake preferred).
  • Experience with ingestion tooling and orchestration (Airbyte, Prefect, or equivalents).
  • Familiarity with agentic coding tools and an understanding of why guardrails around their output matter.
  • Deep curiosity about the business: you want to understand what the data means and how customers use it, not just how it flows.
  • Software engineering discipline for analytics code: Git, code review, CI/CD.
  • Can take a multi‑sprint piece of work from spec to production with normal oversight, and can explain tradeoffs to technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
  • Upper‑intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Experience building or maintaining API services on top of warehouse data (FastAPI or similar).
  • Experience with a semantic layer or governed metric definitions that multiple consumers rely on, including for LLM‑driven or agent‑driven querying.
  • Experience exposing warehouse data to customers through embedded analytics or customer‑facing APIs.
  • Experience with data observability tooling.
  • Experience supporting customer data onboarding or implementation teams.
  • Experience deploying data pipelines across multiple regions and managing PII or sensitive data.
  • Knowledge of procurement and/or supply chain data models.
  • Prior experience in enterprise software and startups.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Professional growth : Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation : USD-based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.
  • Exciting projects : Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies.
