title: Snap Navigator
company: Food Bank of the Southern Tier
description:
At the Food Bank of the Southern Tier, we are committed to creating a future without hunger where access to healthy food by all is recognized as fundamental to the well-being and success of individuals and the foundation of a strong, vibrant society. We strive to be a client-focused, engaged, high-performing team, leading a collaborative effort across our region to ensure equitable access to nutritious food through our values of Integrity, Learning, Inclusion, Caring, Respect, and Abundance.


Do you have a passion for nutrition and community health? Want to make a real difference in the lives of others?


The Food Bank of the Southern Tier (FBST) is seeking a Snap Navigator to join our team!


JOB SUMMARY

The Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) Navigator helps individuals and families access nutrition assistance by coordinating SNAP outreach, assisting with applications, maintaining community partnerships, and documenting services and outcomes within an assigned county. Working primarily at county worksites and community locations, the Navigator organizes daily activities independently within approved plans and program requirements, maintains regular communication with the SNAP Navigator Manager, and works with regional SNAP Navigators and colleagues across Food Bank of the Southern Tier (FBST) departments to coordinate services.

The Navigator serves people from diverse backgrounds and with varied lived experiences, including people experiencing trauma, financial hardship, or barriers to accessing assistance. The role requires compassion, patience, calm communication, and respect for each person’s dignity and choices. Success requires accurate, confidential work, sound judgment, consistent follow-through, and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment while providing attentive, responsive client service.


Reports To: SNAP Navigator Manager


Work Type: On-site. Work occurs at the assigned county worksite and community locations. Attendance at the Food Bank office is required at least one to two days per month. Additional attendance may be required for meetings, training, or operational needs.


Standard Work Schedule: Monday – Thursday, 8:00 a.m. – 4:00 p.m.; Friday, 8:00 a.m. – 1:00 p.m.

Work schedules may be adjusted to accommodate partner visits, outreach events, or other operational needs.


Travel Requirements: Regular travel within the assigned county and travel throughout the six-county service area as needed.


Assigned Service Area
Chemung County
Broome County

Schuyler County


Primary Work Location


Food Bank of the Southern Tier, 388 Upper Oakwood Ave., Elmira, NY 14903

Catholic Charities, 232 Main St., Binghamton, NY 13905

Catholic Charities, 105 9th St. #20, Watkins Glen, NY 14891


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Outreach Planning & Community Education

  • Collaborates with the SNAP Navigator Manager to develop and implement the assigned county’s outreach plan to reach underserved residents, address misconceptions about SNAP, and build community support. Seeks input from the Director of Communications on messaging, outreach materials, and public awareness activities.
  • Develops county outreach schedules and activity plans for review and approval by the SNAP Navigator Manager, using identified community needs and assigned program targets.
  • Identifies outreach locations and service gaps using community needs, partner feedback, and program activity data.
  • Coordinates tabling and outreach at food pantries, meal sites, mobile distributions, schools, healthcare facilities, and other community locations.
  • Prepares and distributes accurate, accessible SNAP information using current program guidance and approved messaging.
  • Delivers community presentations that explain SNAP, address misconceptions, and connect residents with application assistance.
  • Submits proposed outreach materials and publicity to the SNAP Navigator Manager for approval before distribution or publication. Consults the Director of Communications as needed on messaging, branding, and public-facing content.

Client Screening & Application Assistance

  • Responds promptly and professionally to SNAP inquiries from individuals, families, partner agencies, and community organizations.
  • Conducts preliminary eligibility screenings using approved guidance and tools; explains that the administering agency determines eligibility and benefit amounts.
  • Guides applicants through application steps, required documentation, submission, and follow-up within the scope of authorized outreach services.
  • Provides estimated benefit information when supported by approved tools and available information, without guaranteeing eligibility or benefits.
  • Identifies barriers to completing applications, coordinates appropriate follow-up, and refers unresolved or complex issues to the SNAP Navigator Manager or administering agency.
  • Connects individuals with food programs and other community resources appropriate to their stated needs.
  • Provides additional pre-screening and application assistance during staff vacancies or extended absences as assigned by the SNAP Navigator Manager, including service outside the primary county when needed.

Community Partnerships & Worksite Coordination

  • Establishes and maintains productive working relationships with the local Department of Social Services and other community service providers.
  • Coordinates referrals and co-located outreach with partner organizations to improve access and reduce duplication of services.
  • Communicates recurring application barriers and service gaps to the SNAP Navigator Manager and collaborates on approved solutions with community stakeholders.
  • Collaborates with host-site staff, including Catholic Charities staff where assigned, and attends relevant worksite meetings to exchange service updates and coordinate shared workplace needs.
  • Follows established host-site safety, security, shared-space, and operational expectations; raises conflicting instructions or concerns with the SNAP Navigator Manager.
  • Coordinates outreach schedules, referrals, and service handoffs with other SNAP navigators to maintain continuity and avoid duplicate client contacts.

Program Records & Performance Reporting

  • Maintains complete, accurate, and timely client service records, correspondence, referral information, and application outcomes in approved systems.
  • Protects confidential client information through authorized collection, access, storage, transmission, and disposal practices.
  • Prepares assigned activity and outcome reports by established deadlines and verifies entries for completeness and accuracy.
  • Tracks progress toward assigned annual outreach and application-assistance targets, implements approved actions to achieve those targets, and promptly communicates shortfalls, barriers, and recommended adjustments to the SNAP Navigator Manager.
  • Reviews service trends and partner feedback to recommend practical improvements in outreach, client follow-up, and recordkeeping.
  • Maintains documentation of approved business expenses and travel, submits records promptly, and requests required approvals before committing funds.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Organizational Support

  • Collaborates with internal departments, community partners, and other SNAP outreach staff to coordinate program delivery, share relevant information, resolve service concerns, and avoid duplication of services.
  • Exchanges best practices, outreach approaches, and program resources with other SNAP navigators, Feeding America member food banks, and relevant professional networks to strengthen service delivery.
  • Contributes program information, client feedback, service trends, and relevant observations to departmental planning, program evaluation, and continuous improvement activities.
  • Participates in regional SNAP Navigator meetings, cross-departmental meetings, organizational initiatives, and special projects by contributing ideas, collaborating with colleagues, and completing assigned responsibilities that support the Food Bank’s mission and strategic priorities.
  • Serves on organizational committees and workgroups as assigned, attends scheduled meetings, and completes related responsibilities.
  • Maintains a working understanding of Food Bank programs, services, and community resources to provide accurate information, make appropriate referrals, and support coordinated hunger-relief efforts.
  • Attends required statewide SNAP meetings, workshops, and training and applies relevant updates to assigned outreach and application-assistance activities.
  • Refers all media inquiries, public statements, and requests for official organizational information to the Development & Community Engagement Department or other authorized organizational representative and communicates on behalf of the Food Bank only when authorized to do so.
  • Performs other duties and special projects as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Associate’s degree in human services, social work, community services, communications, or a related field preferred; an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience is also acceptable.
  • Minimum of two (2) years of relevant experience in customer service, human services, social services, community outreach, or other client- or community-facing roles.
  • Experience working respectfully and effectively with individuals from diverse socioeconomic, cultural, and lived-experience backgrounds, including individuals who have experienced trauma or are navigating the social safety net, is preferred.
  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, including the ability to explain program requirements, deliver presentations, and build collaborative relationships.
  • Strong organizational, planning, and time-management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, maintain accurate records, and meet deadlines.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and Teams, and the ability to learn client databases, electronic application platforms, and reporting systems.
  • Familiarity with public assistance programs, hunger, food insecurity, and poverty issues preferred.
  • Valid driver’s license, a driving record acceptable to the Food Bank and its insurance carrier, and the ability to travel throughout the assigned county and six-county service area as needed.

title: Chief Medical Officer
description:
Position Summary

The Chief Medical Officer (CMO) serves as the senior clinical leader for Medical Associates Plus (MAP) and is responsible for ensuring the delivery of high-quality, compliant, and patient-centered medical care. The CMO provides strategic oversight of clinical services, ensures compliance with all federal and state regulations, and serves as the final authority on medical matters.

This role collaborates closely with executive leadership, the Board of Directors, and clinical teams to establish and maintain clinical excellence, quality assurance, and regulatory compliance across all service lines.

Responsibilities and Duties

Clinical Leadership & Oversight

  • Serve as the organization’s primary authority on all medical and clinical issues
  • Oversee clinical operations to ensure compliance with federal, state, and accrediting body standards (e.g., HRSA, Joint Commission)
  • Lead and support the delivery of high-quality, patient-centered care across all sites
  • Provide final clinical decision-making in the resolution of medical disputes

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure compliance with all applicable clinical regulations, policies, and standards
  • Serve as the primary contact for medical malpractice claims and oversee claims management processes
  • Ensure FTCA (Federal Tort Claims Act) claims are submitted to the Office of General Counsel and maintain ongoing communication throughout the claims process
  • Participate in the development and implementation of risk management protocols

Strategic Planning & Program Development

  • Collaborate with the CEO, Board Medical Committee, and leadership team to develop clinical policies, goals, and objectives
  • Assist in the development and implementation of the organization’s healthcare plan based on community health needs and epidemiological data
  • Contribute to clinical budgeting, including staffing, equipment, and program development
  • Recommend and establish clinical priorities aligned with organizational strategy

Quality Improvement & Performance Management

  • Lead quality assurance and performance improvement initiatives related to patient care
  • Ensure compliance with accreditation standards, including Joint Commission requirements
  • Review patient satisfaction data and assist in developing improvement strategies
  • Oversee clinical performance metrics and outcomes

Medical Staff Leadership

  • Provide leadership, oversight, and coordination of medical staff and interdisciplinary teams
  • Conduct performance evaluations for providers and recommend employment actions (e.g., hiring, promotions, disciplinary actions)
  • Participate in recruitment, credentialing, and privileging clinical staff
  • Facilitate regular provider meetings and interdisciplinary collaboration

Training & Development

  • Support clinical staff education, onboarding, and ongoing professional development
  • Provide consultation and training to clinical teams as needed
  • Ensure compliance with continuing education requirements and best practice standards

Organizational Representation

  • Represent the medical staff in communications with executive leadership and the Board of Directors
  • Attend Board meetings and present clinical and quality reports as requested
  • Serve as an advocate for the organization within the community, professional organizations, and public health entities

Clinical Services

  • Provide direct patient care as outlined in the physician agreement
  • Maintain current knowledge of clinical best practices, including NHSC and public health guidelines

Additional Duties

  • Perform other duties as assigned by the CEO
  • This position is required to practice in clinic at least two days per week

Qualifications

Education

  • Active, unrestricted license to practice medicine in the State of Georgia
  • Board certification in a primary care specialty

Experience

  • Minimum of three (3) years of experience in clinical, administrative, or academic medicine, preferably in a community health or public health setting
  • Demonstrated leadership experience in a healthcare organization
  • Strong knowledge of healthcare regulations, compliance, and quality improvement practices
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and presentation skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

Working Conditions & Physical Requirements

  • Frequent standing, walking, and use of hands for clinical and administrative tasks
  • Occasional sitting, reaching, bending, or lifting
  • Exposure to moderate noise levels and potential interaction with agitated patients
  • Possible exposure to communicable and infectious diseases
  • Requires visual acuity including close, distance, and color vision

You'll own the full path data takes: from a client's ad accounts and CRM, through Adverity, into a BigQuery warehouse, through modular dbt/Dataform transformations, and out to the Looker Studio dashboards and automated Google Sheets reports the team and its partners rely on daily.   • Drive data quality — monitor pipeline health, resolve API breaks, minimize latency, implement validation frameworks and automated testing, troubleshoot discrepancies to root cause across source/warehouse/BI layers, and proactively flag data quality risks to leadership

  • Strong experience configuring datastreams, transformations, and destinations in Adverity or a comparable ETL platform (Fivetran, Supermetrics, Funnel)

  • Intermediate to advanced SQL, with proven BigQuery experience in transformation, partitioning, and modeling

  • Expertise in dbt or Dataform, managing modular, version‑controlled, documented SQL transformation pipelines

  • Python proficiency for custom API connections and pipeline automation

  • Experience with CRM data flows and integrations (Slate, Salesforce, and/or HubSpot)

  • Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows, and proven ability to manage multi‑client data environments with strict data segregation

  • An analytical, solution‑driven mindset with a growth orientation, and strong communication skills that turn complex data workflows into clear narratives for non‑technical audiences — education marketing experience (traditional or online) is especially valued

  • Familiarity using AI or LLM tools to optimize performance forecasting, automated audience segmentation, or marketing workflows

  • Experience connecting, managing, and maintaining APIs for generative AI platforms within a marketing data architecture

  • Experience using AI/ML‑driven anomaly detection to monitor pipelines and proactively flag data quality issues

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and location

  • A pivotal, high‑visibility seat on a scaling Data & Analytics team, with real ownership over the agency's reporting infrastructure

  • The chance to build the data backbone for an agency whose partners are education and nonprofit organizations working to build a better world

  • Enable the reporting layer — create clean, performant data views built specifically for fast Looker Studio dashboards and automated Google Sheets reports, and partner with the Data and Analytics Manager and client teams to translate reporting requirements into warehouse models

  • Drive data quality — monitor pipeline health, resolve API breaks, minimize latency, implement validation frameworks and automated testing, troubleshoot discrepancies to root cause across source/warehouse/BI layers, and proactively flag data quality risks to leadership

You Bring:

  • 5+ years of hands‑on data engineering experience, ideally in a marketing or agency environment

  • Strong experience configuring datastreams, transformations, and destinations in Adverity or a comparable ETL platform (Fivetran, Supermetrics, Funnel)

  • Intermediate to advanced SQL, with proven BigQuery experience in transformation, partitioning, and modeling

  • Expertise in dbt or Dataform, managing modular, version-controlled, documented SQL transformation pipelines

  • Python proficiency for custom API connections and pipeline automation

  • Experience with CRM data flows and integrations (Slate, Salesforce, and/or HubSpot)

  • A deep understanding of marketing metrics (ROAS, CPA, CAC) and paid platform schemas, with a proven track record of structuring data to optimize Looker Studio performance

  • Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows, and proven ability to manage multi‑client data environments with strict data segregation

  • An analytical, solution‑driven mindset with a growth orientation, and strong communication skills that turn complex data workflows into clear narratives for non‑technical audiences — education marketing experience (traditional or online) is especially valued

Bonus Points:

  • Experience integrating AI‑driven insights or machine learning models into marketing data pipelines to sharpen predictive analytics and data utility

  • Familiarity using AI or LLM tools to optimize performance forecasting, automated audience segmentation, or marketing workflows

  • Experience connecting, managing, and maintaining APIs for generative AI platforms within a marketing data architecture

  • Experience using AI/ML-driven anomaly detection to monitor pipelines and proactively flag data quality issues

What’s Offered:

  • Remote role with the flexibility that comes with a distributed, async-friendly team

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and location

  • A pivotal, high-visibility seat on a scaling Data & Analytics team, with real ownership over the agency's reporting infrastructure

  • The chance to build the data backbone for an agency whose partners are education and nonprofit organizations working to build a better world

  • A culture built around finding a better way, playing as a team of A-players, and treating results as the engine rather than the goal

  • Direct impact: the pipelines and models you build directly shape how partners see (and trust) their own performance data

  • 2 Screening Call with Atomic HR

title: Transportation Recruiting Manager
description:
Transportation Recruiting Manager

Build the Workforce Behind a Growing Transportation Network

At zTrip, people power our success. As the largest taxi transportation provider in the United States, we depend on talented transportation professionals to deliver safe, reliable, and exceptional service every day. We are seeking a motivated and results-oriented Transportation Recruiting Manager to lead talent acquisition efforts that support operational growth and workforce expansion across our markets.

This position is ideal for a recruiting professional who enjoys developing hiring strategies, building community partnerships, and connecting qualified candidates with rewarding career opportunities. As a key member of our team, you'll help ensure zTrip has the talent necessary to meet current demands while preparing for future growth.

Why Join zTrip?

  • Competitive Compensation Package
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
  • 401(k) with Company Match
  • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
  • Career Growth and Advancement Opportunities
  • Ongoing Professional Development
  • Dynamic and Collaborative Work Environment
  • Growing National Transportation Company
  • Opportunity to Influence Workforce Strategy
  • High Visibility and Impact Across Operations

Position Overview

The Transportation Recruiting Manager is responsible for developing and executing recruiting initiatives focused on attracting, hiring, and onboarding transportation professionals. This role serves as a strategic partner to operations leadership by identifying workforce needs, implementing recruiting campaigns, and creating talent pipelines that support business objectives.

The ideal candidate combines recruiting expertise with strong relationship-building skills, operational awareness, and a passion for helping individuals find meaningful career opportunities within the transportation industry.

Primary Responsibilities of a Transportation Recruiting Manager:

Talent Acquisition Strategy

  • Design and execute recruiting plans aligned with organizational staffing goals
  • Develop innovative sourcing strategies to attract qualified transportation professionals
  • Build and maintain talent pipelines for both immediate and future hiring needs
  • Promote zTrip's employment brand through recruiting campaigns and outreach initiatives
  • Continuously evaluate recruiting processes and implement improvements that increase hiring effectiveness

Candidate Engagement & Selection

  • Identify, source, and engage qualified candidates through multiple recruiting channels
  • Conduct interviews and evaluate candidate qualifications, experience, and potential
  • Guide candidates through each phase of the selection process
  • Maintain consistent communication to ensure a positive candidate experience
  • Present employment opportunities and career growth paths available within the organization

Hiring & Onboarding Management

  • Coordinate pre-employment screening activities, including background reviews and verification processes
  • Ensure compliance with company policies and transportation industry requirements
  • Facilitate onboarding activities and new-hire orientation programs
  • Partner with operational leaders to promote successful transitions into active roles
  • Monitor onboarding completion and new-hire integration

Community Outreach & Partnership Development

  • Build relationships with workforce development organizations, community groups, vocational schools, and employment agencies
  • Represent zTrip at hiring events, job fairs, networking opportunities, and career expos
  • Develop referral and outreach programs that generate quality candidate leads
  • Expand recruiting presence throughout local communities and target markets
  • Strengthen zTrip's reputation as an employer of choice within the transportation industry

Workforce Planning & Reporting

  • Collaborate with leadership teams to forecast hiring needs and workforce trends
  • Track recruiting performance metrics and hiring outcomes
  • Analyze applicant flow, conversion rates, and recruiting effectiveness
  • Produce regular hiring and workforce reports for management
  • Recommend strategies that improve hiring success and workforce retention

Qualifications of a Transportation Recruiting Manager:

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in recruiting, talent acquisition, staffing, human resources, or workforce development
  • Prior recruiting experience within transportation, logistics, operations, or high-volume hiring environments preferred
  • Strong interviewing, assessment, and relationship-building skills
  • Experience utilizing applicant tracking systems and recruiting technologies
  • Excellent written and verbal communication abilities
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and decision-making capabilities
  • Self-directed professional with a results-driven approach

Core Competencies

  • Transportation Recruiting
  • Talent Acquisition Leadership
  • Workforce Planning
  • Candidate Relationship Management
  • Hiring Strategy Development
  • Employment Branding
  • Community Networking
  • Interviewing & Candidate Evaluation
  • Onboarding Coordination
  • Recruiting Analytics & Reporting
  • Process Improvement
  • Professional Communication

What Success Looks Like for a Transportation Recruiting Manager:

As the Transportation Recruiting Manager, you will:

  • Consistently meet staffing objectives across assigned markets
  • Build sustainable pipelines of qualified transportation professionals
  • Improve recruiting efficiency and reduce time-to-fill metrics
  • Deliver an exceptional candidate experience from first contact through onboarding
  • Establish strong recruiting partnerships within local communities
  • Support employee retention through quality hiring practices
  • Provide workforce solutions that support business growth
  • Contribute to the long-term success and expansion of zTrip's transportation operations

Make an Impact

The strength of our workforce directly impacts the quality of service we provide. As a Transportation Recruiting Manager, you will play a vital role in identifying talented individuals, strengthening operational teams, and supporting the continued growth of one of the transportation industry's most recognized brands.

If you're passionate about recruiting, workforce development, and helping organizations grow through great people, we invite you to join the zTrip team.

Apply Today

Become a Transportation Recruiting Manager with zTrip and help shape the future of our workforce. Your ability to attract, develop, and connect top transportation talent will directly contribute to our continued success nationwide.

# Job Summary:
In this role, you will plan, develop, and review electrical engineering design work, produce drawings and documentation, and prepare design estimates for a project. You will coordinate with clients, facilitate technical discussions, and review key electrical drawings, calculations, and bid summaries. You will solve complex technical issues and ensure electrical designs comply with all regulations and standards.
# Major Responsibilities:
**Level 1**
+ Evaluates, selects, and applies standard electrical engineering methods, techniques, procedures, and criteria, using independent judgment in making adaptations and modifications.
+ Participates in the design, development and modification of components and processes used in the generation, manipulation, transmission, and storage of electricity utilizing relevant Engineering Department Procedures (EDPs), design standards and guides, and Bechtel Standard Application Programs (BSAPs).
+ Coordinates work and collaborates with other engineering disciplines.
+ Coordinates electrical engineering efforts in assigned areas with specialty groups, engineering disciplines, the client, vendor, contractors, construction and other functional groups.
+ Prepares conceptual studies, designs, reports or proposals.
+ Provides technical assistance to other electrical personnel and will interact with project functions, the customer, and regulatory agency personnel in the resolution of complex regulatory issues and industry codes and standards.
+ Provides assistance to project and construction management in identifying and complying with project electrical requirements and in addressing issues as they arise during project execution.
**Level 2**
+ Designs, develops, modifies, and evaluates components and processes used in the generation, manipulation, transmission and storage of electricity utilizing relevant Engineering Department Procedures (EDPs), design standards and guides, and Bechtel Standard Application Programs (BSAPs).
+ Prepares or assists in preparation of conceptual studies, designs, reports or proposals.
+ When delegated, provides guidance to other electrical engineering personnel for specific tasks or projects.
+ Mentors and assists more junior electrical team members.
+ Completes electrical documentation and procedures for installation and maintenance.
+ Selects components and equipment based on analysis of specifications and reliability.
# Education and Experience Requirements:
**Level 1**
+ Requires bachelor's degree (or international equivalent) and 5-8 years of relevant experience or 9-12 years of relevant work experience
**Level 2**
+ Requires bachelor's degree (or international equivalent) and 8-10 years of relevant experience or 12-14 years of relevant work experience

title: Manager Vendor Management
description:
The Vendor Manager is responsible for managing the overall performance and operations of the company's service delivery sites, including overseeing workforce planning, quality, training, and continuous improvement performance initiatives. They serve as the key point of contact for coordinating site-level activities and driving optimal performance across all sites.

WHAT’S ON YOUR PLATE?

  • Setting and leading the Annual OKRs for the BPOs and Outsourcing Operations in alignment with the operations' direction and strategy, which includes the launching of new sites and driving the performance of all BPOs through the collaboration of the internal Support Functions (WFM, Quality, and Operations Training) as well as being present on ground (within the BPOs Offices) to monitor and drive the performance towards the desired OKRs."
  • Develop and implement strategies to drive continuous improvement in site-level performance, quality, and efficiency
  • Proactively identifies and addresses process gaps and improvement opportunities, taking corrective actions up to the leadership team, such as terminating agents, reducing hours, changing site management, managing invoices, and securing the best deals while maintaining the highest quality.
  • Develop and execute workforce planning strategies to ensure optimal staffing levels and skill mix at the site level
  • Oversee the hiring of site-level personnel, including managers and supervisors, to ensure that they have the needed profiles.
  • Coordinating and managing the company's BPO vendors and service delivery sites
  • Monitor and analyze vendor performance data, driving continuous improvement and optimization, including conducting gap analyses and risk assessments to drive strategic decisions. This involves making decisions on negotiating and renewing vendor contracts
  • Prepare and present comprehensive reports on site-level performance, highlighting key metrics, trends, and recommendations
  • Participate in cross-functional meetings to discuss site-level operations and coordinate with internal stakeholders
  • Ensure compliance with relevant regulations, policies, and security requirements at the site level
  • Maintain a centralized repository of site-level data, contracts, and performance records
  • Stay abreast of industry best practices, trends, and benchmarks in site performance management and workforce optimization
  • Collaborate with internal teams and vendors to develop and implement innovative solutions that drive operational excellence.
  • At least 5 years of experience in Contact Center industry within leadership roles.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to drive data-driven decision-making.
  • Excellent data analysis and reporting capabilities, including the ability to collect, analyze, and interpret performance metrics and KPIs.
  • Proficiency in process improvement methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma) and experience in leading and facilitating process optimization initiatives.
  • Effective negotiation and contract management skills, with the ability to ensure vendor compliance with SLAs and KPIs.
  • Adept at using project management tools.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Knowledge of the relevant industry.
  • Familiarity with contact center technology, tools, and systems, and their integration into vendor operations.

title: Remote Data Engineering Lead | Power Bi & Sql Server
description:
Andworx is hiring a Power BI Developer to develop visually pleasing and accurate data visualizations, reports, and dashboards for our federal government customer. As a candidate, you should be experienced with collaborating as part of a team in the advanced development of rich data visualizations using Microsoft Power BI.

We are looking for a hands-on doer who enjoys working in a fast-paced customer focused environment, who has a background in data analysis and an eye for creating good looking dashboards that tell stories enabling data driven decisions while placing a high importance on user experience, usability, and design. You should be comfortable interacting with stakeholders to elicit requirements in an agile and iterative environment to develop beautiful data visualizations.

Please Note: This position has a hybrid work schedule of up to 2 days per week on-site work with our customer. Candidates must be within a commutable distance to the Washington, DC metro area.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8 or more years of experience creating reports, dashboards, and data visualizations with 5 or more years specifically using Microsoft Power BI.
  • Experience ingesting information, transforming data, and building relationships with data from various feeds.
  • Experience presenting dashboards and quantitative data to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Comprehensive experience with relational database architecture and navigating large datasets, including querying and extracting data from Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server databases, as well as sources such as SharePoint lists, excel spreadsheets, and third-party connectors.
  • Experience writing SQL queries against relational databases; experience with Oracle PL/SQL is highly desirable.
  • Experience with SSRS and Power BI Report Builder.
  • Experience with data modeling, cleansing, and transformation utilizing a tool set including Power BI, SQL, or Power Query, R, Python, etc.
  • Experience using tools such as TOAD or Visual Studio Code to query and extract data from Oracle databases.
  • Expertise with ongoing maintenance and troubleshooting of Power BI-driven reporting ecosystems including query tuning and performance optimization.
  • Strong analytical skills to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate data and information in the BI environment with attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Strong organizational, interpersonal and relationship building skills with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to quickly adapt to changing priorities or tasks.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent years' experience.
  • U.S Citizenship is required.
  • Ability to successfully obtain and maintain a Position of Trust background security investigation and meet eligibility requirements for access to sensitive information.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Technical certifications related to Microsoft Power BI, database design, or data analysis.
  • Knowledge of Tableau or broader experience with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse).

Responsibilities

Show your passion for visual story telling using Microsoft Power BI by leveraging your business intelligence and data analytics experience to construct visually pleasing, rich data visualizations.

  • Design and develop Power BI reports and dashboards, using industry best practices and standards.
  • Identify, analyze, and translate business requirements and rules into intuitive analytical solutions, business scorecards and management dashboards.
  • Work with a variety of stakeholders to easily visualize data from multiple sources in a single platform to aid in the design and development of complex business solutions.
  • Provide operational support for existing Power BI dashboards and reports.
  • Understand reporting database models and schemas and perform data analysis.
  • Connect to various data sources to import and transform data into Power BI.
  • Collaborate in solutioning efforts in the Power BI environment addressing problems, tuning for performance, and diagnosing issues to resolve application bottlenecks and performance issues.
  • Create written and visual data reports and analysis.
  • Provide end-user training, technical demonstrations, and presentations to stakeholders.

144L - Senior DevOps Engineer (AWS/EKS/Terraform/CI/CD) · Remote · LATAM

  • Location: Anywhere in LATAM
  • Work Model: 100% Remote
  • Engagement: Full-time Contractor
  • Payment: USD
  • Project: Identity Security / Cybersecurity Platform
  • Seniority: Senior
  • English Level: B2 / C1

Get to Know Darwoft

At Darwoft, we build custom software solutions and partner with international companies to create high-impact digital products.

We are a Latin American technology company with a people-first culture, strong professional standards, and a long-term partnership mindset. We work with distributed teams, complex technical challenges, and clients whose technology has a direct impact on their businesses and users.

About the Project

We are partnering with an innovative cybersecurity company developing a modern Identity Security and Identity Observability platform .

The product enables enterprise security teams to monitor identity activity, identify security gaps, detect suspicious behavior, and reduce identity-related risks across cloud, SaaS, network, and on-premise environments .

Its architecture relies heavily on distributed systems, real-time data processing, cloud-native infrastructure, advanced analytics, and an increasingly AI-driven security roadmap .

As the platform continues to scale, infrastructure reliability, automation, observability, security, and developer productivity are critical engineering priorities.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to design, automate, operate, and continuously improve the cloud infrastructure and deployment platform supporting a high-scale cybersecurity product.

You'll work primarily with AWS, Kubernetes/EKS, Terraform, Docker, CI/CD, and observability technologies , partnering closely with Software Engineering, QA, Security, and IT teams.

This role goes beyond maintaining infrastructure. You'll actively contribute to platform engineering , helping engineers ship software faster and more reliably while improving automation, security, operational visibility, scalability, and cloud cost efficiency.

You'll have a high degree of ownership over production infrastructure and participate directly in architectural decisions, incident resolution, platform improvements, and DevOps best practices.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design, build, and operate highly available and scalable cloud infrastructure primarily on AWS .
  • Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform .
  • Deploy, manage, scale, and troubleshoot workloads running on Kubernetes , particularly Amazon EKS .
  • Develop automation for infrastructure provisioning, environment configuration, and application deployment.
  • Build and maintain reliable CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab CI .
  • Improve deployment processes, release reliability, and developer experience across engineering teams.
  • Manage containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes .
  • Design and improve observability across infrastructure and applications.
  • Implement monitoring, dashboards, alerts, and centralized logging using technologies such as:
    • Prometheus
    • Grafana
    • AWS CloudWatch
    • OpenSearch / Elasticsearch
    • ELK
  • Participate in production incident response, troubleshooting, mitigation, and root cause analysis .
  • Identify recurring operational issues and automate their resolution.
  • Implement AWS and Kubernetes security best practices.
  • Collaborate with Security teams to strengthen infrastructure security and support compliance initiatives.
  • Improve platform resilience, high availability, scalability, and disaster recovery capabilities.
  • Optimize AWS resource utilization and contribute to cloud cost optimization and FinOps initiatives .
  • Automate operating system and infrastructure configuration using Ansible or similar tools .
  • Develop operational tooling and automation using Python and Bash .
  • Collaborate with Engineering teams on platform architecture and deployment strategies.
  • Continuously evaluate new DevOps, cloud, Kubernetes, observability, and platform engineering technologies.

What You Bring

  • 5–8+ years of experience working in DevOps, Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or similar roles.
  • Strong hands‑on production experience with AWS .
  • Strong experience managing Kubernetes clusters , ideally Amazon EKS .
  • Advanced experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Strong experience with Docker and containerized environments .
  • Hands‑on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with:
    • GitHub Actions
    • Jenkins
    • GitLab CI
    • or similar platforms
  • Strong Linux administration skills.
  • Experience with configuration management tools such as Ansible .
  • Good scripting and automation capabilities with:
    • Python
    • Bash
  • Experience implementing observability using technologies such as:
    • Prometheus
    • Grafana
    • CloudWatch
    • OpenSearch / Elasticsearch
    • ELK
  • Strong understanding of networking concepts including:
    • VPCs
    • Subnets
    • Load Balancers
    • DNS
    • VPNs
    • Firewalls
    • Routing
    • Security Groups
  • Experience troubleshooting complex distributed systems and production environments.
  • Solid understanding of cloud security and infrastructure security best practices.
  • Experience supporting highly available, production‑grade cloud environments.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with engineering, security, QA, and business stakeholders.
  • High degree of autonomy, ownership, and analytical problem‑solving ability.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

Core Technology Stack

You'll work with technologies including:

  • AWS
  • Kubernetes / EKS
  • Docker
  • Terraform
  • Ansible
  • GitHub Actions
  • Jenkins
  • Linux
  • Python
  • Bash
  • Prometheus
  • Grafana
  • CloudWatch
  • OpenSearch / Elasticsearch

Nice to Have

  • Experience with HashiCorp Nomad .
  • Experience with HashiCorp Consul .
  • Broader experience with the HashiCorp ecosystem.
  • Experience operating Kafka in production.
  • Experience supporting data infrastructure based on:
    • ClickHouse
    • Elasticsearch
    • MongoDB

You’ll join the team building workflow software for one of the studio's clients: a live product that needs new workflow features while the existing ones keep running. AI coding tools draft most of the specs, tests and migrations. You direct them, read every diff line by line, and answer for what merges. If you'd rather write most of the code by hand, this probably isn't the right seat.

You report to the studio's leadership and work day to day with the lead developer and the product manager, who sets the acceptance criteria for each sprint. Get to Know Darwoft

At Darwoft, we build custom software solutions and partner with international companies to create high-impact digital products.

We are a Latin American technology company with a people-first culture, strong professional standards, and a long-term partnership mindset. We work with distributed teams, complex technical challenges, and clients whose technology has a direct impact on their businesses and users.

About the Project

We are partnering with an innovative cybersecurity company building a next-generation Identity Security and Identity Observability platform .

The product helps enterprise security teams understand how human users, service accounts, workloads, applications, and AI-driven identities access systems across cloud, SaaS, network, endpoint, and on-premise environments .

At the core of the platform is a highly data-intensive architecture that collects and analyzes large volumes of events, logs, network telemetry, identity activity, and security signals . This information is processed to identify unusual access patterns, security risks, identity blind spots, infrastructure misconfigurations, and potential threats.

The platform integrates with complex enterprise ecosystems including identity providers, cloud platforms, SASE solutions, SIEMs, endpoint security tools, network infrastructure, and security services.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer focused on Data Ingestion, Integrations, and Collectors to become a key technical bridge between enterprise customers and the engineering organization.

This is not a traditional backend or internal data engineering position.

You'll work directly with customers to understand their infrastructure, data sources, security architecture, network topology, APIs, and workflows, then design and implement scalable mechanisms to ingest that information into the platform.

You'll combine data engineering, software engineering, solution architecture, cloud infrastructure, and technical consulting .

A major part of your mission will be building and evolving connectors and ingestion pipelines capable of integrating data from complex enterprise environments while maintaining reliability, scalability, security, and fast time-to-production.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design, develop, and maintain production-grade data collectors, connectors, and ingestion services .
  • Integrate enterprise data sources including identity providers, cloud platforms, SASE solutions, network infrastructure, endpoints, applications, security platforms, and SIEM systems .
  • Work directly with enterprise customers to understand their environments, data flows, APIs, security requirements, and integration constraints.
  • Participate in technical onboarding processes, from initial discovery and architecture design through production deployment.
  • Design scalable ingestion architectures for processing security events, logs, identity activity, network telemetry, and other high-volume data sources .
  • Build integrations using REST APIs, cloud-native services, event-driven architectures, and modern software engineering practices .
  • Develop backend services primarily using Python and/or Go .
  • Work with SQL and NoSQL databases to store, transform, query, and analyze high-volume data.
  • Build and operate containerized services using Docker and Kubernetes .
  • Deploy and integrate solutions across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments .
  • Troubleshoot complex customer deployment and integration issues across application, infrastructure, networking, API, and data layers.
  • Optimize ingestion performance, reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with Solution Architects, Sales Engineering, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering teams.
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor around customer data architecture, collection strategies, security integrations, and implementation best practices.
  • Identify recurring customer requirements and transform them into reusable connectors, platform capabilities, or improvements to the core product.
  • Contribute technical insights from real-world implementations to the product roadmap.
  • Support production adoption and continuously improve time-to-value for enterprise customers.
  • Participate in occasional customer-facing technical sessions and, when necessary, onsite engagements.

What You Bring

  • 10+ years of professional Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, or related experience.
  • Strong software development experience with:
    • Python
    • Go
  • Strong experience designing and consuming REST APIs .
  • Hands-on experience building data ingestion pipelines, connector frameworks, integration platforms, or similar systems .
  • Experience integrating complex enterprise systems and third-party platforms.
  • Solid understanding of both SQL and NoSQL databases .
  • Production experience with at least one major cloud platform:
    • AWS
    • Azure
    • GCP
  • Experience working with Docker and Kubernetes .
  • Strong understanding of Git-based development workflows and CI/CD practices .
  • Experience designing reliable, scalable, and production-ready distributed systems.
  • Strong debugging skills across APIs, infrastructure, networking, application services, and data pipelines.
  • Experience working directly with customers, stakeholders, or technical partners.
  • Ability to translate complex customer requirements into pragmatic technical solutions.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to operate effectively in customer-facing technical conversations.
  • High degree of autonomy and ownership when solving ambiguous technical problems.

Highly Relevant Experience

Experience with any of the following will be especially valuable:

  • IAM
  • IdPs
  • Identity Security
  • Cybersecurity platforms
  • SIEM systems
  • Security telemetry
  • Network security
  • Endpoint security
  • SASE / Zero Trust environments
  • Cloud security
  • Large-scale event processing
  • Streaming architectures

Integration Experience

Previous experience integrating APIs or data from platforms such as the following is highly valuable:

  • AWS
  • Microsoft Azure
  • Google Cloud
  • Microsoft Entra ID / Active Directory
  • Okta
  • Google Workspace
  • Duo
  • CrowdStrike
  • Zscaler
  • Palo Alto
  • Microsoft Defender
  • SIEM and security analytics platforms

Direct experience with every platform is not required. What matters is a strong track record of learning complex APIs and transforming heterogeneous enterprise data sources into reliable integrations.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with large-scale data processing or streaming platforms.
  • Experience designing reusable connector SDKs or integration frameworks .
  • Understanding of identity-related security concepts such as authentication, authorization, credentials, service accounts, privileged access, and non-human identities.
  • Experience with security events, audit logs, network telemetry, or cloud activity data.
  • Familiarity with event-driven and distributed system architectures.
  • Experience deploying AI/ML-enabled applications.
  • Exposure to LLMs, AI agents, or AI-powered security applications .
  • Solution Architecture or Forward Deployed Engineering experience.
  • Previous experience in cybersecurity startups or high-growth SaaS environments.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role will be measured by your ability to:

  • Deliver successful enterprise integrations and deployments.
  • Reduce customer time-to-production.
  • Build reliable and scalable ingestion solutions.
  • Improve customer adoption and technical satisfaction.
  • Resolve complex integration challenges efficiently.
  • Turn customer-specific requirements into reusable platform capabilities.
  • Contribute improvements that strengthen the scalability and flexibility of the core product.

  • Mentalidad de ownership, product thinking y alta orientación a la resolución colaborativa de problemas operativos.

Responsibilities

Show your passion for visual story telling using Microsoft Power BI by leveraging your business intelligence and data analytics experience to construct visually pleasing, rich data visualizations.

  • Identify, analyze, and translate business requirements and rules into intuitive analytical solutions, business scorecards and management dashboards.

Job Summary

Manage the obtaining, maintenance and monitoring of environmental and sectoral permits that enable the execution of the project in Argentina, ensuring that the engineering design, constructive planning and field activities comply with the applicable national and provincial regulations, with the commitments assumed before the authority and with the environmental standards of the client.

The position acts as a bridge between engineering and the regulatory authority: it translates the legal requirements into verifiable design criteria, anticipates the environmental restrictions that condition the layout and the construction sequence, and maintains a critical permit route aligned with the project schedule. Its performance is measured by the absence of regulatory detentions and by the technical quality of the information presented to the competent bodies.

Major Responsibilities

Permission management

  • Preparing and keeping updated the project permits matrix, identifying competent body, submission requirements, legal deadlines and actual processing deadlines.
  • Prepare, review and submit the Environmental Impact Report and its biennial updates, along with the supporting technical documentation required by the provincial mining authority.
  • Managing the associated sectoral permits: water use and concession, effluent dumping, emissions into the atmosphere, hazardous waste management, soil movement, intervention of native vegetation and transport of hazardous substances.
  • Maintaining technical dialogue with provincial and national enforcement authorities, responding to observations, requests for additional information and audits.
  • Timely alert the permits that constitute a critical route and propose sequencing alternatives when a regulatory deadline compromises the schedule.

Environmental studies and assessment

  • Defining the scope of the environmental baselines - air quality, noise, surface and groundwater, soils, flora, fauna, glaciers and periglacial environment, archaeology and socio-economic environment - and technically supervise the consulting firms that execute them.
  • Reviewing consultant deliverables verifying methodological sufficiency, representativeness of sampling and traceability of data before its incorporation into the file.
  • Evaluating environmental impacts of the project, propose mitigation and compensation measures, and verify that they are reflected in the design criteria and technical specifications.
  • Estimating hours, costs and deadlines of environmental studies for their incorporation into the project budget and program.

Compliance, monitoring and interface with the project

  • Keeping track of environmental commitments derived from the Environmental Impact Statement and the permits granted, and periodically verify their compliance on the ground.
  • Providing the engineering disciplines with the environmental constraints applicable to the design - layout restrictions, exclusion areas, discharge limits and water management criteria - and verify their incorporation.
  • Preparing progress reports on the status of permits for the client and for the project management, with status, regulatory risks and mitigation actions.
  • Supporting the processes of citizen participation and relations with communities and local authorities, in coordination with the social area of the project and the client.
  • Issuing the environmental deliverables under the project's documentary control system, respecting the review scheme and the preparation, review and approval signatures.

Regulatory framework of reference

  • Dominating the Argentine environmental regime and its federal articulation: the Nation sets the minimum protection budgets and the provinces, as holders of the original domain of natural resources, are the enforcement authority that grants the permits. The following list is the minimum core required: Law 25.675, Law 24.585; Law 26.639; Law 24.051, Law 25.688, Law 26.331, Law 25.743, Law 25.831, Law 27.520, ILO Convention 169 (Law 24.071).

Jackson Dawson is seeking a Lead AV Technician to serve as the on-site technical lead for Genesis House’s audiovisual and event-technology systems. This hands-on role combines advanced technical expertise with responsibility for system reliability, operational readiness, preventive maintenance, vendor coordination, and continuous improvement.

Reporting to the Facility Manager, with oversight from the Senior Executive Producer, this individual evaluates technical needs, establishes priorities, and makes decisions within approved budgets and delegated authority. The Lead AV Technician partners with the Director of Events on technical planning and execution; the Director of Events retains responsibility for overall event production. Event Technical Planning and Execution

  • Develop AV plans, equipment specifications, cost estimates, and technical schedules in partnership with the Director of Events and relevant vendors.
  • Coordinate technical setup, testing, rehearsals, live support, and strike. Confirm that systems, equipment, and content are tested and ready before guest arrival.
  • Apply enhanced readiness checks for VIP visits, high-profile events, and other critical engagements.
  • Configure and operate AV equipment, manage content playback, and perform troubleshooting and repairs within applicable training, authorization, and safety requirements.
  • Lead the technical response to event-related incidents, implement appropriate backup solutions, and communicate impacts, corrective actions, and expected resolution times to event leadership.
  • Remain accountable for technical issues until normal service is restored, and use post-event reviews to improve reliability, workflows, and service delivery.

Vendor, Resource, and Budget Coordination

  • Evaluate technical vendors, obtain and compare proposals, recommend partners, and negotiate service scope and pricing within delegated authority.
  • Direct the technical work of contracted crews and assigned support personnel, establish expectations, and verify that completed work meets agreed specifications.
  • Monitor approved AV operating and event budgets, review estimates and invoices, identify variances, and secure authorization before exceeding approved spending limits.
  • Assess repair-versus-replacement options and recommend equipment upgrades based on reliability, compatibility, lifecycle cost, and guest experience.
  • Coordinate with building management and qualified service providers on power, HVAC, building management systems, and other facility conditions affecting AV performance. Escalate work requiring licensed or specialized trades.

Stakeholder Partnership and Technical Standards

  • Serve as the primary on-site AV resource for Jackson Dawson and Genesis stakeholders, clearly explaining technical options, limitations, trade-offs, and recommendations.
  • Own technical requests and incidents from initial notification through resolution. Acknowledge requests promptly, establish priorities and timelines, provide status updates, and confirm completion.
  • Maintain proactive communication with Facilities, Operations, Events, hospitality, and building-management teams to align technical readiness, maintenance, and event requirements.
  • Maintain processes for organizing, versioning, validating, and archiving media assets. Confirm playback compatibility and use of approved content.
  • Train designated staff on routine system operation, first-response troubleshooting, and escalation procedures.
  • Keep leadership informed of system health, maintenance activities, unresolved risks, technical incidents, vendor performance, and upcoming resource needs. Identify clear owners and next steps for outstanding issues.
  • Maintain a polished, discreet, and service-oriented presence when working with clients, VIP guests, talent, and production partners.
  • Anticipate guest-facing technical needs and resolve issues with urgency and minimal disruption.
  • Perform additional responsibilities as assigned to support business needs and venue operations.

Qualifications

Required

  • At least five years of progressively responsible experience in professional AV operations, live-event technology, or integrated venue systems, including demonstrated technical leadership.
  • Strong working knowledge of professional audio, digital mixing, wireless microphones, lighting controls, LED and video systems, signal routing, and media playback.
  • Ability to interpret signal-flow diagrams and troubleshoot network-connected AV devices, control systems, and interactions among hardware, software, and content platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate alternatives, establish technical priorities, identify risks, and make sound recommendations with limited day-to-day direction.
  • Experience coordinating technical vendors, reviewing proposals, developing estimates, and monitoring approved spending.
  • Ability to remain composed during time-sensitive incidents while communicating clearly and prioritizing guest experience and safety.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and client-service skills, including the ability to guide technical crews and explain technical issues to nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Relevant technical training; an associate or bachelor’s degree in audiovisual technology, electronics, information technology, or a related field; or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred

  • Experience in luxury hospitality, experiential brand environments, cultural venues, or high-profile corporate events.
  • AVIXA Certified Technology Specialist (CTS) certification or relevant manufacturer certifications.
  • Experience with LED systems, Dante, Q-SYS, Crestron, Extron, or comparable technologies.
  • Familiarity with backup power, HVAC and building management system interfaces, and other facility infrastructure affecting AV performance.

Schedule and Work Environment

  • This position requires regular on-site attendance at Genesis House.
  • Evening, weekend, and holiday availability is required based on the event calendar and scheduled maintenance.
  • Participation in an established after-hours escalation and coverage schedule is required for critical technical issues. Coverage expectations will be communicated in advance whenever practicable.
  • Occasional opening and closing responsibilities are required in coordination with venue leadership.

Physical Requirements

The role involves standing and moving throughout the facility, using stairs, positioning equipment, and bending, stooping, or kneeling as needed. Candidates must be able to safely lift or move equipment weighing up to 50 pounds using appropriate assistance and safe work practices.

Essential functions may be performed with or without reasonable accommodation.

title: Remote Full-Stack & Power Bi Developer — Sql & Cubes
description:
Our client is a remote product studio that builds MVPs and custom software for startups and companies past the idea stage. Clients hire them for a fixed-scope MVP or for a product team billed by the two-week sprint, and the whole team uses AI coding tools every day.

They've been at it since 2020 and were profitable in 2025, with a 30% net margin. After building their own AI systems, they tripled monthly revenue with the same team size. Clients rate them 4.9 out of 5 in verified reviews, and the startups they build for have raised more than $25M in venture funding.

Your Role

You’ll join the team building workflow software for one of the studio's clients: a live product that needs new workflow features while the existing ones keep running. The client's own engineers commit to the same repo, so every new table, permission and workflow goes in next to code someone else is changing. The weight is on the server side, from the SQL database on Azure up through the API, and you also build the React and TypeScript screens that sit on top.

AI coding tools draft most of the specs, tests and migrations. You direct them, read every diff line by line, and answer for what merges. If you'd rather write most of the code by hand, this probably isn't the right seat.

You report to the studio's leadership and work day to day with the lead developer and the product manager, who sets the acceptance criteria for each sprint. Success means delivering four to five features per two-week sprint, each verified before merge, and owning one area end to end (such as the task engine or the legacy migration) without breaking a live feature.

You Bring:

  • 4+ years building full-stack web applications and releasing them to production
  • Experience working in a codebase you didn't write, learning its conventions before changing it
  • Hands-on work on workflow software where different user roles see different data, with approvals, task queues or state machines and an audit log or versioned history
  • React, TypeScript and SQL on Azure, including schema design and migrations
  • Daily use of Cursor, Claude Code or a similar AI coding tool on production work, with tests and CI behind it
  • Clear written and spoken English
  • Experience delivering in fixed-scope sprints with branches, code review and feature flags

Bonus Points:

  • Work in a regulated setting such as finance, health or insurance
  • A migration from a legacy system, with reconciliation and duplicate review
  • Time as an outside vendor committing to a client's repo
  • Project rules, custom prompts or agent setups for AI coding tools that your team adopted
  • Spanish, since the platform is bilingual

What's Offered:

  • Fully remote contractor role from LATAM, full time at about 40 hours a week
  • Core hours in US time zones, so your day overlaps with the lead developer and the product manager
  • An area of the product to own end to end, with your schema designs reviewed by the lead developer and the client's engineers
  • A team where AI-first delivery is already the daily routine, with tests, CI and feature flags as part of the normal process
  • A start in early November

Interview Process:

  • 1 Intro Call: 30 minutes with atomic HR on your background and goals
  • 2 Leadership Screening: A short call, possibly with an async part first
  • 3 Product and Developer Conversation: How you take features from acceptance criteria to merge
  • 4 Take-Home Test: One feature like the real scope, built and checked

title: Senior Data Engineer: Ingestion & Integrations Remote Latam
description:
AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to operate and improve a Snowflake-based enterprise data platform in a regulated healthcare environment.

MUST HAVES

- 5+ years of professional experience in Data Engineering or Data Platform Engineering.

- Strong hands-on experience operating and developing solutions on Snowflake , including data-layer design, warehouse performance, access patterns, and production troubleshooting.

- Advanced SQL skills and strong experience with dbt for transformation, testing, documentation, lineage, and controlled deployment.

- Experience operating managed ingestion tools such as Fivetran or HVR and supporting custom data-ingestion pipelines.

- Hands-on experience with AWS data services , particularly S3 and event-driven or file-based ingestion patterns.

- Experience orchestrating and troubleshooting data workloads with Argo Workflows on Kubernetes , or comparable workflow-orchestration technologies.

- Proficiency in Python or a comparable language for data engineering, automation, and operational tooling.

- Strong understanding of data modeling, pipeline dependencies, schema evolution, backfills, data validation, and production data quality.

- Experience with observability, logging, alerting, and incident-management practices for production data platforms.

- Demonstrated ability to lead complex incident resolution, perform root-cause analysis, and convert findings into preventive improvements.

- Ability to make well-reasoned technical decisions, identify tradeoffs, estimate work, and guide improvements across a complex platform.

- Experience mentoring engineers and collaborating effectively with Cloud / DevOps, Analytics, Security, Governance, and business stakeholders.

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to work directly with client stakeholders.

- Full availability to work from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Pacific Time and participate in an agreed on-call rotation.

NICE TO HAVES

- Hands-on experience with a data-specific observability platform.

- Experience supporting Tableau Cloud administration, data-source connectivity, extracts, scheduled refreshes, or production dashboard dependencies.

- Familiarity with Snowflake cost optimization, audit logging, tasks, stored procedures, and environment rationalization.

- Experience migrating legacy ingestion or orchestration patterns such as Boomi or AWS Data Pipeline to modern managed or Kubernetes-based solutions.

- Experience with Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code practices supporting data platforms.

- Experience with service-management and change-control tools such as Freshservice and Jira.

- Familiarity with HIPAA, GDPR, FDA-related controls, least-privilege access, separation of duties, and audit-ready operational practices.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Provide senior technical ownership for the Data Platform service tower during the LatAm coverage window, including day-to-day operations, complex troubleshooting, and L2/L3 escalation.

- Operate and improve Snowflake production and non-production environments, including warehouse configuration and sizing, performance and consumption monitoring, object lifecycle, environment hygiene, and support for production changes.

- Administer data access within established controls, including users, roles, service accounts, secrets, and credential rotation, while maintaining least-privilege and audit-ready practices.

- Operate and improve data ingestion across Fivetran, HVR where applicable, and custom pipelines, including connector configuration, scheduling, source onboarding, schema-change coordination, failure recovery, backfills, and dependency management.

- Design, build, and maintain reliable pipelines and dbt models across RAW, CURATED, and CONSUMPTION layers, with appropriate testing, documentation, lineage, version control, and CI/CD practices.

- Support AWS S3 data-lake operations, including raw and landing-zone workflows, lifecycle and retention controls, access patterns, logging, ingestion failures, and coordination with downstream Snowflake workloads.

- Support Argo Workflows and Kubernetes-hosted data workloads in close coordination with the Cloud / DevOps team, including scheduling, troubleshooting, deployment, recovery, and capacity dependencies.

- Define and improve data quality and observability standards, including freshness, zero-row, row-count growth, null, duplicate, schema-drift, and referential-integrity checks.

- Expand end-to-end monitoring and lineage using tools such as SYNQ, dbt, Snowflake audit data, Splunk, and the agreed alerting stack, linking actionable alerts to evidence and runbooks.

- Lead or support major data incidents, root-cause analysis, post-incident reviews, and preventive actions across ingestion, orchestration, Snowflake, and downstream Tableau dependencies.

- Support Tableau Cloud operations where upstream data, connectivity, permissions, extracts, or refresh failures require Data Platform investigation.

- Identify and deliver standardization, automation, reliability, performance, and cost improvements, including migration of suitable legacy or custom extraction patterns toward agreed golden paths.

- Execute work through controlled incident, request, access, change, and release processes using established service-management workflows.

- Create and maintain runbooks, operating procedures, architecture context, ownership information, recovery procedures, and knowledge-transfer materials.

- Mentor Middle-level engineers, review technical work, improve team practices, and ensure effective handoffs across the distributed service team.

- Participate in the Data Platform on-call rotation for critical incidents outside staffed service hours.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

- Professional growth : Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.

- Competitive compensation : USD-based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.

- Exciting projects : Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies.

- Flextime : Flexible schedule with remote and office options.

# Job Summary:
Manage the obtaining, maintenance and monitoring of environmental and sectoral permits that enable the execution of the project in Argentina, ensuring that the engineering design, constructive planning and field activities comply with the applicable national and provincial regulations, with the commitments assumed before the authority and with the environmental standards of the client.
The position acts as a bridge between engineering and the regulatory authority: it translates the legal requirements into verifiable design criteria, anticipates the environmental restrictions that condition the layout and the construction sequence, and maintains a critical permit route aligned with the project schedule. Prepare, review and submit the Environmental Impact Report and its biennial updates, along with the supporting technical documentation required by the provincial mining authority.

+ Maintaining technical dialogue with provincial and national enforcement authorities, responding to observations, requests for additional information and audits.
+ Timely alert the permits that constitute a critical route and propose sequencing alternatives when a regulatory deadline compromises the schedule.

+ Dominating the Argentine environmental regime and its federal articulation: the Nation sets the minimum protection budgets and the provinces, as holders of the original domain of natural resources, are the enforcement authority that grants the permits. Get to Know Darwoft

At Darwoft, we build custom software solutions and partner with international companies to create high-impact digital products.

We are a Latin American technology company with a people-first culture, strong professional standards, and a long-term partnership mindset. We work with distributed teams, complex technical challenges, and clients whose technology has a direct impact on their businesses and users.

About the Project

We are partnering with an innovative cybersecurity company building a next-generation Identity Security and Identity Observability platform .

The product helps enterprise security teams understand how human users, service accounts, workloads, applications, and AI-driven identities access systems across cloud, SaaS, network, endpoint, and on-premise environments .

At the core of the platform is a highly data-intensive architecture that collects and analyzes large volumes of events, logs, network telemetry, identity activity, and security signals . This information is processed to identify unusual access patterns, security risks, identity blind spots, infrastructure misconfigurations, and potential threats.

The platform integrates with complex enterprise ecosystems including identity providers, cloud platforms, SASE solutions, SIEMs, endpoint security tools, network infrastructure, and security services.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer focused on Data Ingestion, Integrations, and Collectors to become a key technical bridge between enterprise customers and the engineering organization.

This is not a traditional backend or internal data engineering position.

You'll work directly with customers to understand their infrastructure, data sources, security architecture, network topology, APIs, and workflows, then design and implement scalable mechanisms to ingest that information into the platform.

You'll combine data engineering, software engineering, solution architecture, cloud infrastructure, and technical consulting .

A major part of your mission will be building and evolving connectors and ingestion pipelines capable of integrating data from complex enterprise environments while maintaining reliability, scalability, security, and fast time-to-production.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design, develop, and maintain production-grade data collectors, connectors, and ingestion services .
  • Integrate enterprise data sources including identity providers, cloud platforms, SASE solutions, network infrastructure, endpoints, applications, security platforms, and SIEM systems .
  • Work directly with enterprise customers to understand their environments, data flows, APIs, security requirements, and integration constraints.

  • Develop backend services primarily using Python and/or Go .
  • Work with SQL and NoSQL databases to store, transform, query, and analyze high-volume data.
  • Build and operate containerized services using Docker and Kubernetes .

  • Act as a trusted technical advisor around customer data architecture, collection strategies, security integrations, and implementation best practices.
  • Identify recurring customer requirements and transform them into reusable connectors, platform capabilities, or improvements to the core product.
  • Contribute technical insights from real-world implementations to the product roadmap.
  • Support production adoption and continuously improve time-to-value for enterprise customers.
  • Participate in occasional customer-facing technical sessions and, when necessary, onsite engagements.

    • Python

  • Hands-on experience building data ingestion pipelines, connector frameworks, integration platforms, or similar systems .
  • Experience integrating complex enterprise systems and third-party platforms.
  • Solid understanding of both SQL and NoSQL databases .
  • Production experience with at least one major cloud platform:
    • AWS
    • Azure
    • GCP
  • Experience working with Docker and Kubernetes .
  • Strong understanding of Git-based development workflows and CI/CD practices .
  • Experience designing reliable, scalable, and production-ready distributed systems.
  • Strong debugging skills across APIs, infrastructure, networking, application services, and data pipelines.
  • Experience working directly with customers, stakeholders, or technical partners.
  • Ability to translate complex customer requirements into pragmatic technical solutions.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to operate effectively in customer-facing technical conversations.
  • High degree of autonomy and ownership when solving ambiguous technical problems.

Highly Relevant Experience

Experience with any of the following will be especially valuable:

  • IAM
  • IdPs
  • Identity Security
  • Cybersecurity platforms
  • SIEM systems
  • Security telemetry
  • Network security
  • Endpoint security

  • Cloud security

The Opportunity

Are you ready to turn your passion into a high-octane career? We’re looking for a sharp, driven Fit Specialist to join our fast-paced team. In this role, you’ll be at the heart of our store operations, keeping our logistics seamless, our inventory accurate, and our riders ready for action.

What You’ll Own & Achieve:

  • Deliver Customized Fit Consultations: Guide customers through personalized bike fit assessments, matching riders to the right powersports vehicle, seat adjustments, handlebars, controls, and riding gear.
  • Provide Top-Tier Customer Engagement: Build genuine relationships with riders, answering technical questions and delivering a welcoming, world-class showroom experience.
  • Promote Accessories & Ergonomic Upgrades: Recommend custom parts, accessories, and fit enhancements to optimize rider comfort, safety, and performance.
  • Collaborate Across Departments: Work seamlessly with Vehicle Sales, Parts, and Service departments to ensure complete, customized delivery for each customer.
  • Maintain Showroom Standards: Ensure fitment display areas and vehicles are clean, organized, and properly showcased.
  • Stay Product Informed: Keep up to date with new powersports models, ergonomic features, and custom options.
  • Achieve Monthly Sales Goals: Consistently meet or exceed individual and team monthly sales targets in a dynamic, high-pressure environment.
  • Other duties and responsibilities as assigned
